section_definitions.title: Business overview
section_definitions.prompt: Explain what the company does, who pays it, and why the business exists. Cite primary sources.

section_definitions.title: Revenue model and segments
section_definitions.prompt: Describe revenue streams, segments, geographic exposure, pricing, and recurring versus transactional revenue. Date every mix figure.

section_definitions.title: Products and services
section_definitions.prompt: Describe the main products, customer problems solved, distribution, and product dependencies.

section_definitions.title: Customers and end markets
section_definitions.prompt: Describe buyers, use cases, concentration, contract duration, and end-market exposure. Do not infer undisclosed customer names.

section_definitions.title: Industry and value chain
section_definitions.prompt: Place the company among suppliers, distribution channels, customers, and substitutes. Explain cyclicality and supply constraints.

section_definitions.title: Competitive landscape
section_definitions.prompt: Identify direct competitors and alternatives. Compare specific products or business segments, with sources.

section_definitions.title: Moat and differentiation
section_definitions.prompt: Separate evidence from interpretation when assessing switching costs, cost advantages, intellectual property, scale, or network effects.

section_definitions.title: Growth drivers
section_definitions.prompt: Explain the mechanisms behind possible growth, their dependencies, and what would disprove them. Label forecasts and assumptions.

section_definitions.title: Financial performance
section_definitions.prompt: Record revenue, margins, earnings, cash flow, and relevant sector metrics. Every number needs period, units, currency, accounting basis, and source. Separate reported results, guidance, consensus, and estimates.

section_definitions.title: Balance sheet and capital allocation
section_definitions.prompt: Describe cash, debt, maturities, dilution, stock compensation, investment, acquisitions, dividends, and repurchases with dates and sources.

section_definitions.title: Management and governance
section_definitions.prompt: Describe leadership, ownership, incentives, governance, and execution history. Verify current roles and date the evidence.

section_definitions.title: Valuation context
section_definitions.prompt: Explain suitable valuation metrics and assumptions. Timestamp prices, share counts, net debt, and multiples; distinguish historical, current, and forward figures. Do not present an undated fair value.

section_definitions.title: Catalysts
section_definitions.prompt: List dated events, the mechanism by which they matter, uncertainty, and the next evidence to monitor. A scheduled event is not a guaranteed outcome.

section_definitions.title: Risks and thesis breakers
section_definitions.prompt: Describe operational, financial, regulatory, and competitive risks and measurable conditions that would invalidate an interpretation.

section_definitions.title: Scenarios and open questions
section_definitions.prompt: Separate bull, base, and bear assumptions from facts. Record missing data, disputed evidence, and research questions without inventing answers.

section_definitions.title: Relationships and themes
section_definitions.prompt: Link relevant companies and cross-sector themes. State the relationship type and supporting source; never imply all theme members are competitors.

section_definitions.title: Recent developments
section_definitions.prompt: Keep a dated, source-backed log of material changes. Distinguish the event date from the article date and explain what changed in the profile.

section_definitions.title: Sources and change log
section_definitions.prompt: List source IDs from the metadata and describe material research changes. Preserve conflicting or superseded evidence with dates and explanations.

business-overview.text: Microsoft sells business and consumer software, cloud infrastructure, devices, advertising, and gaming. Customers pay for subscriptions, usage, licenses, hardware, and services. Its Nasdaq common-stock ticker is MSFT.

evidence.locator: Cover page; Item 1, General / What We Offer

business-overview.text_he: מיקרוסופט מוכרת תוכנה עסקית וצרכנית, תשתיות ענן, מכשירים, פרסום ומשחקים. ההכנסות מגיעות ממינויים, שימוש, רישיונות, חומרה ושירותים. המניה הרגילה נסחרת בנאסד״ק תחת MSFT.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: FY2026 used Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Effective FY2027, reporting changes to Agents and Infra and Devices and Consumer. Azure becomes more narrowly consumption-based infrastructure; historical segment comparisons require the September recast.

evidence.locator: Updated segment reporting / Changes to segments and investor metrics

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: בשנת FY2026 המגזרים היו Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud ו־More Personal Computing. החל מ־FY2027 הדיווח עובר ל־Agents and Infra ול־Devices and Consumer. הגדרת Azure מצטמצמת לתשתית מבוססת צריכה; השוואות היסטוריות דורשות את ההצגה המחודשת מספטמבר.

products-and-services.text: The September reporting presentation groups Microsoft 365 and GitHub with Azure in Agents and Infra. This combines enterprise applications and agents with the infrastructure that runs workloads; Devices and Consumer includes Windows, Xbox, and search/advertising.

evidence.locator: Updated segment reporting: Agents and Infra; Devices and Consumer

products-and-services.text_he: מצגת הדיווח מספטמבר מצרפת את Microsoft 365 ואת GitHub ל־Azure במגזר Agents and Infra, המחבר יישומים וסוכנים ארגוניים עם תשתית העומסים. Devices and Consumer כולל Windows, Xbox וחיפוש ופרסום.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Distribution combines direct enterprise and public-sector sales, partners serving organizations of varied sizes, OEM software preinstallation, and digital marketplaces. Enterprise consumption, employee subscriptions, PC purchasing, advertising, and gaming create distinct demand exposures.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Distribution, Sales, and Marketing; Operating Segments

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: ההפצה כוללת מכירה ישירה לארגונים ולמגזר הציבורי, שותפים, התקנת תוכנה מראש אצל יצרני מחשבים וחנויות דיגיטליות. צריכת ענן, מינויים לעובדים, רכישת מחשבים, פרסום ומשחקים תלויים בגורמי ביקוש שונים.

industry-and-value-chain.text: Microsoft operates cloud infrastructure and sells the applications above it. In July management described its own Maia and Cobalt chips alongside NVIDIA and AMD hardware; datacenter deployment and utilization constrain how quickly demand becomes billable capacity.

evidence.locator: Satya Nadella prepared remarks, cloud infrastructure and silicon

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: מיקרוסופט מפעילה תשתיות ענן ומוכרת יישומים מעליהן. ביולי ההנהלה תיארה שימוש בשבבי Maia ו־Cobalt שלה לצד חומרת NVIDIA ו־AMD. פריסת מרכזי נתונים וניצולם מגבילים את קצב הפיכת הביקוש לקיבולת שניתן לחייב עליה.

competitive-landscape.text: Competition differs by product: Office faces established and AI-first application vendors; Dynamics faces cloud and on-premises business software; Azure faces competing infrastructure and platform services. This packet does not establish relative market shares.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Operating Segments / Competition

competitive-landscape.text_he: התחרות משתנה לפי מוצר: Office מתחרה ביישומים ותיקים וביישומי AI; Dynamics בתוכנה עסקית בענן ובאתר הלקוח; Azure בשירותי תשתית ופלטפורמה. המחקר אינו קובע נתחי שוק יחסיים.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: integrating enterprise applications, identity, developer tools, and infrastructure may reduce customer integration work and increase switching costs. Product breadth and distribution support that mechanism, but do not establish permanent pricing power or immunity from substitutes.

evidence.locator: Updated segment reporting: stack layers and Agents and Infra
Item 1, Intelligent Cloud / Competition, identity and security portfolio; Distribution, Sales, and Marketing

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: שילוב יישומים ארגוניים, זהויות, כלי פיתוח ותשתיות עשוי לצמצם עבודת אינטגרציה ולהגדיל עלויות מעבר. רוחב המוצרים וההפצה תומך במנגנון הזה, אך אינו מוכיח כוח תמחור קבוע או חסינות מחלופות.

growth-drivers.text: Interpretation: Copilot adoption, premium Microsoft 365 products, and Azure consumption can expand spending within existing accounts. The July call attributed Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud growth to premium products and seat additions; sustained growth requires useful deployment and sufficient capacity, not merely signed contracts.

evidence.locator: Amy Hood prepared remarks, Microsoft 365 Commercial and Azure results

growth-drivers.text_he: פרשנות: אימוץ Copilot, מוצרי Microsoft 365 מתקדמים וצריכת Azure עשויים להרחיב הוצאות של לקוחות קיימים. בשיחת יולי יוחסה צמיחת Microsoft 365 Commercial בענן למוצרים מתקדמים ולתוספת משתמשים. צמיחה מתמשכת דורשת שימוש מועיל וקיבולת מספקת, ולא רק חוזים חתומים.

financial-performance.text: For FY2026 ended June 30, GAAP revenue was USD 331,839 million, operating income USD 155,237 million, net income USD 133,749 million, and diluted EPS USD 17.95. FY2025 revenue was USD 281,724 million. Net income includes investment effects; the issuer separately reconciles non-GAAP results excluding OpenAI investment impacts.

evidence.locator: Income Statements; Fiscal Year 2026 Results; Non-GAAP Definition

financial-performance.text_he: בשנת FY2026 שהסתיימה ב־30 ביוני, הכנסות GAAP היו 331,839 מיליון דולר, הרווח התפעולי 155,237 מיליון, הרווח הנקי 133,749 מיליון והרווח המדולל למניה 17.95 דולר. הכנסות FY2025 היו 281,724 מיליון דולר. הרווח הנקי כולל השפעות השקעה; החברה מפרסמת בנפרד התאמת non-GAAP המחריגה השפעות השקעה ב־OpenAI.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At June 30, 2026, cash, equivalents, and short-term investments were USD 76,843 million. FY2026 operating cash flow was USD 182,935 million and cash additions to property and equipment were USD 115,948 million. Cash capex excludes noncash finance-lease additions; lease obligations also matter when assessing financial capacity.

evidence.locator: Balance Sheets; Cash Flows Statements
Amy Hood prepared remarks, capital expenditures and finance leases

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־30 ביוני 2026 מזומנים, שווי מזומנים והשקעות קצרות היו 76,843 מיליון דולר. תזרים מפעילות בשנת FY2026 היה 182,935 מיליון ותוספות במזומן לרכוש קבוע היו 115,948 מיליון. השקעות הוניות במזומן אינן כוללות תוספות חכירה מימונית שאינן במזומן; יש להביא בחשבון גם התחייבויות חכירה.

management-and-governance.text: The September 15 announcement identifies Satya Nadella as chairman and CEO, Amy Hood as CFO, and Sandra E. Peterson as lead independent director. Combining chair and CEO roles makes independent board oversight relevant; a full compensation and ownership review remains outstanding.

evidence.locator: Annual shareholders meeting hosts

management-and-governance.text_he: הודעת 15 בספטמבר מציינת את Satya Nadella כיו״ר ומנכ״ל, את Amy Hood כסמנכ״לית כספים ואת Sandra E. Peterson כדירקטורית העצמאית המובילה. שילוב תפקידי יו״ר ומנכ״ל מדגיש את חשיבות הפיקוח העצמאי. סקירה מלאה של תגמול ובעלות טרם הושלמה.

catalysts.text: The issuer lists October 28, 2026 for FY2027 first-quarter earnings. Interpretation: the release should test cloud demand and spending efficiency and provide the first quarterly reporting under the new segment structure. A scheduled release does not imply a favorable result.

evidence.locator: Upcoming Microsoft FY27 Q1 Earnings / next earnings release date
Item 7.01, effective FY2027 reporting structure

catalysts.text_he: החברה מציינת את 28 באוקטובר 2026 כמועד תוצאות הרבעון הראשון של FY2027. פרשנות: הפרסום יאפשר לבחון ביקוש לענן ויעילות הוצאות, ויהיה הדיווח הרבעוני הראשון במבנה המגזרים החדש. תאריך מתוכנן אינו מעיד על תוצאה חיובית.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Material risks include cybersecurity failures, competition, regulatory constraints, and cloud capacity or supply shortfalls. Interpretation: persistent weak utilization or cloud monetization relative to infrastructure spending would undermine the growth thesis even if reported revenue keeps rising.

evidence.locator: Item 1A, competition, cloud and AI strategy, cybersecurity and infrastructure risks

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: הסיכונים כוללים כשלי סייבר, תחרות, מגבלות רגולטוריות ומחסור בקיבולת ענן או באספקה. פרשנות: ניצול חלש או הכנסות ענן חלשות ביחס להשקעה בתשתיות לאורך זמן יערערו את תזת הצמיחה, גם אם ההכנסות הכוללות יעלו.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Scenario assumptions: bull—AI applications and Azure utilization reinforce each other; base—growth continues with capital demands; bear—capacity commitments outlast profitable demand. Track cash conversion, lease obligations, and comparable segment margins. These are research hypotheses without assigned probabilities or price targets.

evidence.locator: Amy Hood prepared remarks, capex, cash flow and FY27 outlook

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: הנחות תרחיש: בחיובי יישומי AI וניצול Azure מחזקים זה את זה; בבסיסי הצמיחה נמשכת לצד דרישות הון; בשלילי התחייבויות קיבולת נמשכות מעבר לביקוש הרווחי. יש לעקוב אחר המרה למזומן, חכירות ושולי רווח במגזרים בני השוואה. אלה השערות ללא הסתברויות או מחירי יעד.

relationships-and-themes.text: Microsoft and Palantir announced a government-cloud and classified-network partnership on August 8, 2024. It combines Azure infrastructure and Azure OpenAI with Palantir platforms; the announcement made classified availability subject to authorization. This is an integration relationship, not evidence of exclusivity or identical competition.

evidence.locator: Partnership scope and authorization condition

relationships-and-themes.text_he: מיקרוסופט ופלנטיר הודיעו ב־8 באוגוסט 2024 על שיתוף פעולה בענן ממשלתי וברשתות מסווגות. הוא משלב תשתיות Azure ו־Azure OpenAI עם פלטפורמות פלנטיר; הזמינות בסביבה מסווגת הותנתה באישורים. זהו קשר אינטגרציה ואינו מוכיח בלעדיות או תחרות זהה.

recent-developments.text: September 2, 2026: Microsoft announced its FY2027 segment redesign. September 15: the board declared a USD 0.98 quarterly dividend per share, payable December 10 to holders of record November 19. The declaration is not a completed payment.

evidence.locator: Dividend declaration
Item 7.01

recent-developments.text_he: ב־2 בספטמבר 2026 מיקרוסופט הודיעה על שינוי מגזרים ל־FY2027. ב־15 בספטמבר הדירקטוריון הכריז על דיבידנד רבעוני של 0.98 דולר למניה, לתשלום ב־10 בדצמבר לבעלי מניות רשומים ב־19 בנובמבר. ההכרזה אינה תשלום שבוצע.

MSFT-FY2026-SCOPE-REVIEW.source_name: Microsoft FY2026 annual report financial statements and Notes 2, 10, 13 and 15

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments.label: Short-term Investments
us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments.description: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

scenarios.label: Bear
scenarios.rationale: AI capacity spending outpaces monetization; depreciation and power costs compress margins, and stock compensation exceeds repurchases. Slower cloud growth and a lower multiple reinforce downside.
scenarios.rationale_he: ההשקעה בתשתיות AI מקדימה את ההכנסות; פחת ועלויות חשמל לוחצים על הרווחיות, והדילול עולה על הרכישות העצמיות. האטה בענן וירידת מכפיל מצטרפות לתרחיש השלילי.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A lower earnings multiple reflects weaker durability and higher risk.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.rationale: Azure and enterprise AI support growth that gradually moderates. Cash conversion recovers as new capacity is utilized. Future margins do not extrapolate the annual investment-gain benefit; modest net repurchases reduce the diluted denominator.
scenarios.rationale_he: Azure ויישומי AI לארגונים תומכים בצמיחה שמתמתנת בהדרגה. ניצול הקיבולת החדשה משפר את התזרים. המרווחים אינם משכפלים את רווחי ההשקעות של שנת הבסיס, ורכישות עצמיות מצמצמות מעט את הדילול.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A selected mid-case earnings multiple, not a market consensus or peer-derived target.

scenarios.label: Bull
scenarios.rationale: Copilot adoption and Azure utilization keep growth high while operating leverage and improving cash capex intensity lift margins. This requires demonstrable monetization of AI investment and supports the assumed premium multiple.
scenarios.rationale_he: אימוץ Copilot וניצול Azure שומרים על צמיחה גבוהה. יתרון הגודל וירידה בעצימות ההשקעה במזומן משפרים מרווחים. נדרשת הוכחה שהשקעות AI מניבות הכנסות ותזרים כדי להצדיק את המכפיל.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A premium earnings multiple requires durable growth and cash conversion.

business-overview.text: Oracle supplies enterprise databases, cloud infrastructure, business applications, hardware, and services. Its NYSE common-stock ticker is ORCL.

evidence.locator: Cover page; Item 1, Business

business-overview.text_he: אורקל מספקת מסדי נתונים לארגונים, תשתיות ענן, יישומים עסקיים, חומרה ושירותים. המניה הרגילה נסחרת בבורסת ניו יורק תחת ORCL.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: FY2026 reportable businesses are cloud and software, hardware, and services. Subscription and consumption cloud revenue coexist with software licenses and support; these streams have different revenue-recognition patterns.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Our Businesses; Note 1, revenue recognition

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: בשנת FY2026 העסקים המדווחים הם ענן ותוכנה, חומרה ושירותים. הכנסות ענן ממינויים ומצריכה מתקיימות לצד רישיונות ותמיכה בתוכנה, עם דפוסי הכרה שונים בהכנסה.

products-and-services.text: OCI supplies infrastructure; Oracle Database supports enterprise data; Fusion serves ERP, HCM, and customer workflows; NetSuite targets smaller organizations; Oracle Health serves healthcare.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Oracle Applications and Infrastructure Technologies

products-and-services.text_he: OCI מספקת תשתיות; Oracle Database מנהל נתוני ארגונים; Fusion משרתת ERP, HCM ותהליכי לקוחות; NetSuite פונה לארגונים קטנים יותר; Oracle Health משרתת בריאות.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Oracle serves enterprises and government across industries. Cloud-infrastructure demand and application renewals should be assessed separately; this packet does not quantify customer concentration.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Cloud and Software Business; Sales and Marketing

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: אורקל משרתת ארגונים וממשלות בענפים שונים. יש להעריך בנפרד ביקוש לתשתיות ענן וחידושי יישומים. המחקר אינו מכמת ריכוזיות לקוחות.

industry-and-value-chain.text: Interpretation: cloud expansion couples software demand to datacenter construction, power, and component supply. Capacity delivery and financing are therefore operating constraints, not merely accounting details.

evidence.locator: Remaining Performance Obligations; Safe Harbor risk factors

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: פרשנות: התרחבות הענן קושרת ביקוש לתוכנה לבניית מרכזי נתונים, לחשמל ולרכיבים. מסירת קיבולת ומימונה הם מגבלות תפעוליות ולא רק פרטים חשבונאיים.

competitive-landscape.text: Oracle names Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Salesforce, SAP, and other vendors among competitors across its offerings. This broad list does not mean every named company competes in every product.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition

competitive-landscape.text_he: אורקל מציינת בין מתחרותיה את Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Salesforce, SAP וספקים נוספים. הרשימה הרחבה אינה אומרת שכל חברה מתחרה בכל מוצר.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: embedded databases and integrated applications may make migration costly. That hypothesis requires renewal and customer evidence; the annual report also describes intense competition and customer demand for lower complexity.

evidence.locator: Item 1, applications and infrastructure; Competition

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: מסדי נתונים מוטמעים ויישומים משולבים עשויים לייקר מעבר. ההשערה דורשת ראיות לחידושים וללקוחות; הדוח מתאר גם תחרות חזקה ודרישת לקוחות להפחתת מורכבות.

growth-drivers.text: Management guided FY2027 revenue to at least USD 90,000 million and non-GAAP EPS to USD 8.10 on September 10. These are forecasts dependent on execution and demand, not reported results.

evidence.locator: Guidance for Full FY 2027

growth-drivers.text_he: ב־10 בספטמבר ההנהלה חזתה לשנת FY2027 הכנסות של לפחות 90,000 מיליון דולר ורווח non-GAAP למניה של 8.10 דולר. אלה תחזיות התלויות בביצוע ובביקוש, ולא תוצאות מדווחות.

financial-performance.text: FY2027 Q1 ended August 31, 2026: GAAP revenue USD 19,345 million, operating income USD 6,728 million, net income available to common shareholders USD 4,679 million, and diluted EPS USD 1.56.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, three months ended August 31, 2026

financial-performance.text_he: רבעון Q1 בשנת FY2027 הסתיים ב־31 באוגוסט 2026: הכנסות GAAP היו 19,345 מיליון דולר, הרווח התפעולי 6,728 מיליון, הרווח הנקי הזמין לבעלי מניות רגילות 4,679 מיליון והרווח המדולל למניה 1.56 דולר.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: Q1 operating cash flow of USD 23,103 million included USD 11,363 million of customer prepayments with a significant financing component. Cash capex was USD 28,499 million; net ATM equity proceeds were USD 19,909 million. Interpretation: cash generation must be assessed alongside prepayment financing and dilution.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: תזרים מפעילות ברבעון Q1 בסך 23,103 מיליון דולר כלל מקדמות לקוחות בעלות רכיב מימון משמעותי בסך 11,363 מיליון. השקעות הוניות במזומן היו 28,499 מיליון ותמורה נטו מהנפקות מניות ATM הייתה 19,909 מיליון. פרשנות: יש להעריך יצירת מזומן לצד מימון במקדמות ודילול.

management-and-governance.text: The September 25 proxy lists Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia as CEOs, Hilary Maxson as CFO, and Safra Catz as executive vice chair. This supersedes older descriptions naming Catz as CEO.

evidence.locator: Proxy summary / fiscal 2026 named executive officers

management-and-governance.text_he: מסמך האסיפה מ־25 בספטמבר מציין את Clay Magouyrk ואת Mike Sicilia כמנכ״לים, את Hilary Maxson כסמנכ״לית כספים ואת Safra Catz כסגנית יו״ר פעילה. זה מעדכן תיאורים ישנים שבהם Catz הייתה המנכ״לית.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Interpretation: delayed capacity, weak conversion of commitments to revenue, or continued cash demands beyond accessible funding would challenge the cloud thesis. Large prepayments do not remove execution obligations.

evidence.locator: MD&A, Liquidity and Capital Resources; cash flows
Safe Harbor risk factors

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: פרשנות: עיכובי קיבולת, המרה חלשה של התחייבויות להכנסות או דרישות מזומן העולות על המימון הנגיש יערערו את תזת הענן. מקדמות גדולות אינן מבטלות חובות ביצוע.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Bull: delivered capacity converts demand profitably. Base: expansion consumes capital before returns mature. Bear: demand or utilization disappoints while commitments persist. These are assumptions; customer concentration and contract financing require deeper review.

evidence.locator: Remaining Performance Obligations; Capital Investment Program

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: בחיובי הקיבולת שנמסרת ממירה ביקוש לרווח; בבסיסי ההתרחבות צורכת הון לפני הבשלת התשואה; בשלילי הביקוש או הניצול מאכזבים וההתחייבויות נותרות. אלה הנחות; ריכוזיות לקוחות ומימון חוזים דורשים בדיקה נוספת.

relationships-and-themes.text: The September earnings release explicitly positions Oracle AI Data Platform against Palantir-style enterprise ontologies. This is Oracle marketing positioning, not independent proof of superior capability or a commercial partnership.

evidence.locator: New Oracle AI Data Platform Automatically Generates Enterprise Ontology

relationships-and-themes.text_he: בהודעת ספטמבר אורקל ממצבת את AI Data Platform מול אונטולוגיות ארגוניות בסגנון פלנטיר. זהו מיצוב שיווקי של אורקל, ולא הוכחה עצמאית ליכולת עדיפה או לשותפות מסחרית.

recent-developments.text: September 12, 2026: Oracle announced Larry Ellison cancelled his stock-sale plan, with no sales under that plan before cancellation. The September 14 filing documents the event; cancellation is not an insider purchase.

evidence.locator: Item 8.01, Other Events

recent-developments.text_he: ב־12 בספטמבר 2026 אורקל הודיעה כי Larry Ellison ביטל תוכנית מכירת מניות, ללא מכירות לפיה קודם לביטול. הדיווח מ־14 בספטמבר מתעד זאת; ביטול תוכנית אינו רכישת בעל עניין.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:NotesPayableCurrent.label: Notes Payable, Current
us-gaap:NotesPayableCurrent.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

us-gaap:LongTermNotesPayable.label: Notes Payable, Noncurrent
us-gaap:LongTermNotesPayable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:DebtCurrent.label: Debt, Current
us-gaap:DebtCurrent.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

limitations: Company Facts excludes custom taxonomy and dimensional/segment facts; absent data is not zero.

Weighted-average diluted shares and period-end outstanding shares are separate concepts, and neither is a current quote-date share count.
Cash excludes marketable securities unless independently presented as short_term_investments. Cash plus investments is not assumed to be unrestricted cash.

business-overview.text: Palantir sells software that connects organizational data to operational decisions for commercial and government users. PLTR common stock is listed on Nasdaq in the 2026 quarterly filing.

evidence.locator: Cover page; MD&A, Overview

business-overview.text_he: פלנטיר מוכרת תוכנה המחברת נתונים ארגוניים להחלטות תפעוליות אצל לקוחות מסחריים וממשלתיים. בדוח הרבעוני של 2026 המניה הרגילה PLTR רשומה בנאסד״ק.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: Government and commercial are separate operating segments. Revenue is generally recognized across contract terms, so current revenue can lag changes in new sales or renewals.

evidence.locator: Item 7, Overview; risk factor on revenue recognized over contractual terms

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: ממשלה ומסחר הם מגזרי פעילות נפרדים. הכנסות מוכרות בדרך כלל לאורך תקופות החוזה, ולכן הכנסות בהווה עשויות לפגר אחרי שינוי במכירות חדשות ובחידושים.

products-and-services.text: Foundry integrates data and workflows through the Ontology; AIP connects AI models to governed operations; Apollo delivers software updates; Gotham supports defense and intelligence missions.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Our Platforms

products-and-services.text_he: Foundry מחברת נתונים ותהליכים באמצעות Ontology; AIP מחברת מודלי AI לפעילות תחת בקרה; Apollo מספקת עדכוני תוכנה; Gotham תומכת במשימות ביטחון ומודיעין.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Customers span government and commercial organizations. Government procurement and commercial deployment differ; multi-period contracts and termination provisions make contracted deal value an imperfect proxy for future recognized revenue.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Customers; Item 1A, government contracts and termination provisions

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: הלקוחות כוללים ארגונים ממשלתיים ומסחריים. רכש ממשלתי ופריסה מסחרית שונים זה מזה; חוזים רב־תקופתיים וסעיפי ביטול הופכים את שווי העסקאות למדד חלקי להכנסה עתידית שתוכר.

industry-and-value-chain.text: AIP connects third-party, open-source, or self-hosted models with customer data and actions. Interpretation: Palantir sells operational integration and governance rather than being interchangeable with the underlying model suppliers.

evidence.locator: Item 1, AIP

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: AIP מחברת מודלים מצד שלישי, בקוד פתוח או באירוח עצמי לנתוני לקוחות ולפעולות. פרשנות: פלנטיר מוכרת אינטגרציה ובקרה תפעולית, ולכן אינה תחליף זהה לספקי המודלים עצמם.

competitive-landscape.text: Palantir identifies internal software development as a central alternative, alongside enterprise software vendors, government contractors, and systems integrators. The issuer does not provide a complete ranked competitor map.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition

competitive-landscape.text_he: פלנטיר מזהה פיתוח תוכנה פנימי כחלופה מרכזית, לצד ספקי תוכנה ארגונית, קבלני ממשלה ואינטגרטורים. החברה אינה מספקת מפת מתחרים מלאה ומדורגת.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: an Ontology embedded in operational workflows can create switching costs. The claim depends on durable customer use and value; product descriptions alone cannot establish retention or pricing power.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Ontology and Foundry

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: Ontology המוטמעת בתהליכי עבודה עשויה ליצור עלויות מעבר. הדבר תלוי בשימוש ובערך מתמשכים ללקוח; תיאור מוצר בלבד אינו מוכיח שימור או כוח תמחור.

growth-drivers.text: On August 3 management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to USD 8,150–8,158 million. This forecast depends on continued deployment and expansion; it is neither earned revenue nor consensus.

evidence.locator: Outlook, full year 2026

growth-drivers.text_he: ב־3 באוגוסט ההנהלה העלתה את תחזית הכנסות 2026 ל־8,150–8,158 מיליון דולר. התחזית תלויה בהמשך פריסה והתרחבות, ואינה הכנסה שכבר הורווחה או קונצנזוס אנליסטים.

financial-performance.text: For Q2 2026 ended June 30, GAAP revenue was USD 1,935.464 million, operating income USD 912.004 million, and net income attributable to common stockholders USD 1,061.890 million. Diluted GAAP EPS was USD 0.41. Common-stockholder net income differs from consolidated net income.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, three months ended June 30, 2026

financial-performance.text_he: ברבעון Q2 של 2026 שהסתיים ב־30 ביוני הכנסות GAAP היו 1,935.464 מיליון דולר, הרווח התפעולי 912.004 מיליון והרווח הנקי המיוחס לבעלי מניות רגילות 1,061.890 מיליון. הרווח המדולל GAAP למניה היה 0.41 דולר. הרווח לבעלי מניות רגילות שונה מהרווח הנקי המאוחד.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At June 30, cash and equivalents were USD 2,030.047 million and marketable securities USD 7,379.052 million. Q2 GAAP stock-based compensation expense was USD 265.209 million. Interpretation: assess equity compensation and dilution alongside cash generation.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets; Note 9, Stock-based Compensation Expense

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־30 ביוני מזומנים ושווי מזומנים היו 2,030.047 מיליון דולר וניירות ערך סחירים 7,379.052 מיליון. הוצאות תגמול מבוסס מניות לפי GAAP ברבעון Q2 היו 265.209 מיליון. פרשנות: יש להעריך תגמול הוני ודילול לצד יצירת מזומן.

management-and-governance.text: The August release identifies Alex Karp as CEO. The quarterly filing describes founder-controlled Class F voting rights subject to an ownership threshold; ordinary shareholders should distinguish economic ownership from voting influence.

evidence.locator: Opening CEO statement
Note 8, Stockholders Equity / Class F common stock

management-and-governance.text_he: הודעת אוגוסט מציינת את Alex Karp כמנכ״ל. הדוח הרבעוני מתאר זכויות הצבעה של המייסדים באמצעות Class F בכפוף לסף בעלות; יש להבחין בין בעלות כלכלית להשפעה בהצבעה.

catalysts.text: The August 3 outlook called for Q3 2026 revenue of USD 2,160–2,164 million. The next results will test that guidance; an independently verified release date was not retained in this packet.

evidence.locator: Outlook, Q3 2026

catalysts.text_he: תחזית 3 באוגוסט צפתה הכנסות של 2,160–2,164 מיליון דולר ברבעון Q3 של 2026. התוצאות הבאות יבחנו אותה; המחקר אינו כולל מועד פרסום שאומת באופן עצמאי.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Interpretation: long sales cycles, contract termination, deployment friction, and data or AI governance failures can impede growth. Repeated weak conversion of deals to durable production revenue would challenge the adoption thesis.

evidence.locator: Forward-Looking Statements, sales cycles, termination and deployment risks

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: פרשנות: מחזורי מכירה ארוכים, ביטול חוזים, קשיי פריסה וכשלי ממשל נתונים או AI עלולים לעכב צמיחה. המרה חלשה חוזרת מעסקאות להכנסות עמידות משימוש בפועל תערער את תזת האימוץ.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Bull: customers expand production use; base: deployment remains uneven; bear: internal alternatives or procurement constraints slow adoption. These are assumptions. Contract durability, customer-level economics, and the recurring role of investment gains remain open questions.

evidence.locator: MD&A, Overview / Results of Operations; Item 1A risks

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: בחיובי לקוחות מרחיבים שימוש בפועל; בבסיסי הפריסה לא אחידה; בשלילי חלופות פנימיות או מגבלות רכש מאטות אימוץ. אלה הנחות. עמידות חוזים, כלכלת לקוח ותפקידם החוזר של רווחי השקעות עדיין דורשים בירור.

relationships-and-themes.text: The 2024 Microsoft partnership pairs Palantir platforms with Azure government and classified environments. Classified availability was subject to authorization. This establishes an integration relationship, not exclusivity or proof that all announced deployments occurred.

evidence.locator: Partnership scope and authorization condition

relationships-and-themes.text_he: שותפות Microsoft משנת 2024 משלבת את פלטפורמות פלנטיר עם Azure ממשלתי ומסווג. זמינות מסווגת הותנתה באישור. זהו קשר אינטגרציה, ללא הוכחת בלעדיות או השלמת כל הפריסות שהוכרזו.

recent-developments.text: August 3, 2026: Palantir reported Q2 results and raised full-year guidance. The August 4 quarterly filing supplies GAAP statements and updated risk disclosures; adjusted operating income and cash-flow measures require their separate reconciliations.

evidence.locator: Q2 Financial Summary; Outlook; non-GAAP reconciliations
Financial Statements; Item 1A, Risk Factors

recent-developments.text_he: ב־3 באוגוסט 2026 פלנטיר פרסמה תוצאות Q2 והעלתה תחזית שנתית. הדוח מ־4 באוגוסט מספק דוחות GAAP וסיכונים מעודכנים; רווח תפעולי ותזרימים מתואמים מחייבים התאמות נפרדות.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.label: Cost of Revenue
us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

qa_flags.impact: Per-share and share-count histories require a corporate-action review before valuation or cross-period modeling.
Debt amounts must be reconciled for lease coverage, complete borrowing scope and carrying value before an enterprise-value bridge.

business-overview.text: Micron designs and manufactures semiconductor memory and storage: DRAM, NAND and NOR. It sells components and integrated solutions for data centers, computers, mobile devices, vehicles and industrial systems.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Business, Overview and Product Technologies, pp. 7-8

business-overview.text_he: מיקרון מתכננת ומייצרת זיכרון ואחסון מוליכים למחצה: DRAM, NAND ו־NOR. היא מוכרת רכיבים ופתרונות משולבים למרכזי נתונים, מחשבים, טלפונים, כלי רכב ומערכות תעשייתיות.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: The FY2026 reporting units are Cloud Memory, Core Data Center, Mobile and Client, and Automotive and Embedded. Cloud Memory includes hyperscaler memory and all data-center HBM; Core Data Center includes data-center storage.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Products by Business Unit and Market, pp. 9-11

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: יחידות הדיווח בשנת FY2026 הן Cloud Memory, Core Data Center, Mobile and Client ו־Automotive and Embedded. Cloud Memory כולל זיכרון לענקיות ענן ואת כל זיכרון HBM למרכזי נתונים; Core Data Center כולל אחסון למרכזי נתונים.

products-and-services.text: Micron announced HBM4 volume shipments and high-volume production of SOCAMM2 low-power memory modules and its 9650 PCIe Gen6 SSD. These address different bottlenecks: accelerator memory bandwidth, CPU memory capacity and access to stored data. Performance comparisons in the announcement are issuer tests, not independent benchmarks.

evidence.locator: March 16 release, News highlights, product descriptions and footnotes 1-6

products-and-services.text_he: מיקרון הודיעה על משלוחים בהיקף מסחרי של HBM4 ועל ייצור בהיקף גבוה של מודולי SOCAMM2 חסכוניים ושל כונן 9650 PCIe Gen6 SSD. המוצרים מטפלים ברוחב פס לזיכרון מאיצים, בקיבולת זיכרון למעבדים ובגישה לנתונים מאוחסנים. השוואות הביצועים הן בדיקות החברה, ולא מדד עצמאי.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Customer contracts include short-duration purchases and multi-year take-or-pay commitments. Some strategic agreements have price floors and ceilings; payments normally follow delivery.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Marketing and Customers, p. 12

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: חוזי הלקוחות כוללים רכישות קצרות טווח והתחייבויות רב־שנתיות מסוג take-or-pay. בחלק מההסכמים האסטרטגיים יש רצפות ותקרות מחיר; התשלום נעשה בדרך כלל לאחר המסירה.

industry-and-value-chain.text: Management says additional cleanroom space is needed to address memory supply constraints, while new fabs require gradual production ramps. Its expectation of tight supply through calendar 2028 is an outlook, not proof that memory cyclicality has ended.

evidence.locator: Prepared remarks, Manufacturing expansions pp. 2-3 and Market outlook p. 5

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: ההנהלה מציינת צורך בתוספת שטחי חדרים נקיים כדי להקל מגבלות אספקה, בעוד שמפעלים חדשים דורשים עלייה הדרגתית בייצור. ציפייתה למחסור עד שנת 2028 היא תחזית, ואינה הוכחה לסיום המחזוריות בענף הזיכרון.

competitive-landscape.text: The FY2026 filing names Samsung, SK hynix, Kioxia, Sandisk, CXMT and YMTC as memory/storage competitors. Pricing and process execution remain competitive variables.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competitive Conditions, p. 12

competitive-landscape.text_he: הדוח לשנת FY2026 מציין את Samsung, SK hynix, Kioxia, Sandisk, CXMT ו־YMTC כמתחרות בזיכרון ובאחסון. תמחור וביצוע תהליכי הייצור נותרו גורמי תחרות.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: qualification within a jointly engineered accelerator platform and integration across memory and storage can make substitution harder during a platform cycle. The March product announcement supports technical integration; it does not establish durable monopoly power, independent performance leadership or guaranteed future margins.

evidence.locator: March 16 release, collaboration statement and product integration descriptions

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: הסמכה בפלטפורמת מאיצים שפותחה בשיתוף ושילוב בין זיכרון לאחסון עשויים להקשות על החלפה במהלך מחזור פלטפורמה. הודעת המוצרים ממרץ תומכת באינטגרציה טכנית, אך אינה מוכיחה מונופול עמיד, עליונות ביצועים עצמאית או שולי רווח מובטחים.

growth-drivers.text: Management links longer AI context windows, larger models and concurrent workloads to more memory and storage content. It also expects SSD adoption for KV-cache offload. The mechanism depends on customers deploying the systems and sustaining memory requirements.

evidence.locator: Prepared remarks, Data center, pp. 3-4

growth-drivers.text_he: ההנהלה קושרת חלונות הקשר ארוכים, מודלים גדולים ועומסים מקבילים לעלייה בתכולת הזיכרון והאחסון. היא גם צופה שימוש בכונני SSD להעברת KV-cache. המנגנון תלוי בפריסת המערכות ובהמשך צורכי הזיכרון של הלקוחות.

financial-performance.text: For fiscal Q4 ended September 3, 2026, GAAP revenue was USD 54,229 million, net income USD 37,701 million and gross margin 86.8%. FY2026 GAAP revenue was USD 133,188 million and net income USD 84,969 million. The fiscal year contained 53 weeks.

evidence.locator: Quarterly Financial Results and Annual Financial Results, pp. 1-2
Definitions, fiscal-year convention, p. 5

financial-performance.text_he: ברבעון Q4 שהסתיים ב־3 בספטמבר 2026 הכנסות GAAP היו 54,229 מיליון דולר, הרווח הנקי 37,701 מיליון ושיעור הרווח הגולמי 86.8%. בשנת FY2026 הכנסות GAAP היו 133,188 מיליון והרווח הנקי 84,969 מיליון דולר. שנת הכספים כללה 53 שבועות.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At September 3, 2026, GAAP cash and equivalents were USD 38,364 million; current debt was USD 491 million and long-term debt USD 4,688 million. These cash figures exclude investments. Customer deposits are liabilities, not earned revenue.

evidence.locator: Consolidated Balance Sheets, p. 6
Note 1, Revenue Recognition / Contract Liabilities

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־3 בספטמבר 2026 מזומנים ושווי מזומנים לפי GAAP היו 38,364 מיליון דולר, החוב השוטף 491 מיליון והחוב לטווח ארוך 4,688 מיליון. המזומנים אינם כוללים השקעות. פיקדונות לקוחות הם התחייבויות ולא הכנסות שהורווחו.

management-and-governance.text: The October 9 filing identifies Sanjay Mehrotra as chairman and CEO, Mark Murphy as CFO, and Manish Bhatia as president and COO. Executive incentives and beneficial ownership require separate proxy review.

evidence.locator: Information About Our Executive Officers, pp. 20-21

management-and-governance.text_he: הדיווח מ־9 באוקטובר מציין את Sanjay Mehrotra כיו״ר ומנכ״ל, Mark Murphy כסמנכ״ל כספים ו־Manish Bhatia כנשיא ומנהל תפעול. תמריצים ובעלות מהותית דורשים סקירת מסמכי אסיפה נפרדת.

catalysts.text: Management targets initial Singapore HBM packaging output in early calendar 2027 and Idaho ID1 wafer output in mid-2027. Monitor commissioning, qualification and subsequent shipment ramp separately; initial output is not full capacity. These targets may change.

evidence.locator: Prepared remarks, Manufacturing expansions, pp. 2-3

catalysts.text_he: ההנהלה מכוונת לתחילת תפוקת אריזת HBM בסינגפור בתחילת 2027 ולתפוקת פרוסות במפעל Idaho ID1 באמצע 2027. יש להבחין בין הפעלה, הסמכה וגידול במשלוחים; תפוקה ראשונית אינה קיבולת מלאה. היעדים עשויים להשתנות.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Selling-price declines, supply expansion and trade restrictions can hurt results. Interpretation: sustained pricing weakness or failed qualification would undermine the assumption that product differentiation protects earnings.

evidence.locator: Item 1A, Risk Factors; product pricing, competition, technology and trade restrictions

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: ירידות מחירים, הרחבת היצע ומגבלות סחר עלולות לפגוע בתוצאות. פרשנות: חולשת תמחור ממושכת או כישלון בהסמכה יערערו את ההנחה שבידול המוצרים מגן על הרווחים.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Interpretive scenarios: bull assumes stronger content growth and successful product qualification; base assumes gradual capacity ramps; bear assumes supply catches demand while customers resist pricing. Track shipment mix, realized pricing and customer acceptance. Scenario probabilities and earnings estimates remain unmodeled.

evidence.locator: Prepared remarks, Data center and Market outlook, pp. 3-5

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: תרחישים פרשניים: בחיובי תכולת הזיכרון צומחת וההסמכות מצליחות; בבסיסי הקיבולת עולה בהדרגה; בשלילי ההיצע משיג את הביקוש והלקוחות מתנגדים למחירים. יש לעקוב אחר תמהיל משלוחים, מחיר ממומש וקבלת הלקוחות. לא נבנו הסתברויות או אומדני רווח.

relationships-and-themes.text: NVIDIA is a documented platform collaborator: Micron designed the announced HBM4 and SOCAMM2 offerings for Vera Rubin and optimized the 9650 SSD for BlueField-4 STX. This is a supply-chain/platform relationship, not evidence that Micron competes with NVIDIA in GPUs.

evidence.locator: March 16 release, NVIDIA collaboration and product integration descriptions

relationships-and-themes.text_he: NVIDIA היא שותפה מתועדת לפלטפורמה: מיקרון תכננה את מוצרי HBM4 ו־SOCAMM2 שהוכרזו עבור Vera Rubin והתאימה את כונן 9650 ל־BlueField-4 STX. זהו קשר בשרשרת אספקה ובפלטפורמה, ואינו ראיה שמיקרון מתחרה ב־NVIDIA במעבדים גרפיים.

recent-developments.text: On September 30, Micron reported new server-RDIMM sampling, customer qualifications and expanded SSD applications alongside fiscal-year results.

evidence.locator: Product Highlights, p. 3

recent-developments.text_he: ב־30 בספטמבר מיקרון דיווחה על דגימות חדשות של server-RDIMM, הסמכות לקוח ויישומי SSD מורחבים, לצד תוצאות שנת הכספים.

recent-developments.text: Sampling and qualification are product milestones, not proof of recognized sales. Future refreshes should connect these milestones to reported shipments, revenue and customer acceptance.

evidence.locator: Product Highlights, p. 3

recent-developments.text_he: דגימה והסמכה הן אבני דרך של מוצר, ואינן הוכחה למכירות שהוכרו. עדכונים עתידיים צריכים לקשור אותן למשלוחים, להכנסות ולקבלת הלקוחות.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DebtCurrent.label: Debt, Current
us-gaap:DebtCurrent.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.label: Debt and Lease Obligation
us-gaap:DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.description: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

normalization_reviews.limitation: Only the listed exact source observations are reviewed. This does not certify other periods, current quote-date shares, missing facts, full statements or an enterprise-value bridge.

limitations: Company Facts excludes custom taxonomy and dimensional/segment facts; absent data is not zero.
Company Facts does not carry the full filing context. Revisions may reflect restatements, stock splits, scope changes or tagging differences; flagged revisions are not automatically reconciled.
Fiscal labels come from primary filing focus and annual boundaries; SEC calendar frames are retained only as provenance.
Standalone quarters derived from cumulative values use exact matching fiscal starts/tags/units; cross-filing inputs are disclosed. EPS and weighted-average shares are never subtracted.

Debt lease coverage, short-term borrowings, principal versus carrying value, and unverified share cells require filing-level review before valuation. Explicit split and scope reviews cover exact approved observations only. Weighted-average diluted shares and period-end outstanding shares are separate concepts, and neither is a current quote-date share count.

scenarios.label: Bear
scenarios.rationale: After near-term expansion, memory supply catches demand: falling DRAM/NAND prices and underutilization cause a deep earnings cycle. Fab commitments consume cash even as profit contracts; dilution and a low exit multiple add downside.
scenarios.rationale_he: לאחר צמיחה בטווח הקרוב, היצע הזיכרון משיג את הביקוש. ירידת מחירי DRAM ו-NAND וניצולת נמוכה גורמות לירידה חדה ברווח. התחייבויות למפעלים צורכות מזומן, והדילול והמכפיל הנמוך מחמירים את התוצאה.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A lower earnings multiple reflects weaker durability and higher risk.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.rationale: FY2027 expansion is followed by a deliberate memory-cycle downturn in FY2029 and partial recovery. HBM mix and customer agreements help, but new capacity erodes unusually high margins. Gross cash capex remains a material cash burden.
scenarios.rationale_he: הצמיחה ב-FY2027 מתחלפת במחזור ירידה ב-FY2029 ובהתאוששות חלקית. תמהיל HBM והסכמים עם לקוחות מסייעים, אך קיבולת חדשה שוחקת רווחיות חריגה. ההשקעה הגולמית במפעלים ממשיכה לצרוך מזומן.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A selected mid-case earnings multiple, not a market consensus or peer-derived target.

scenarios.label: Bull
scenarios.rationale: AI memory demand and supply discipline delay a sharp downcycle. HBM execution and long-duration agreements sustain strong margins, while capacity additions still lower margins by FY2030. No net dilution and a higher multiple are additional assumptions.
scenarios.rationale_he: ביקוש לזיכרון AI ומשמעת היצע דוחים ירידה חדה במחזור. ביצועי HBM והסכמים ממושכים תומכים ברווחיות, אך תוספת הקיבולת עדיין מורידה מרווחים עד FY2030. גם היעדר דילול ומכפיל גבוה הם הנחות.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A premium earnings multiple requires durable growth and cash conversion.
