business-overview.text: NVIDIA supplies accelerated-computing platforms combining processors, networking, systems and software for AI, graphics and other compute-intensive workloads.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Our Company, p. 4

business-overview.text_he: אנבידיה מספקת פלטפורמות מחשוב מואץ המשלבות מעבדים, תקשורת, מערכות ותוכנה ל־AI, לגרפיקה ולעומסים עתירי חישוב.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: Reportable segments are Compute & Networking and Graphics. The Q2 FY2027 market presentation groups revenue into Data Center and Edge Computing; those market categories are not the reportable segments.

evidence.locator: Note 13, Segment Information, pp. 22-24

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: המגזרים המדווחים הם Compute & Networking ו־Graphics. הצגת השווקים ברבעון Q2 של FY2027 מקבצת הכנסות ל־Data Center ול־Edge Computing; קטגוריות השוק אינן המגזרים המדווחים.

products-and-services.text: CUDA and acceleration libraries accompany GPU platforms; NVIDIA also sells networking and enterprise software. The August release reports Vera Rubin ramping into full production.

evidence.locator: Highlights / Data Center
Item 1, Data Center, pp. 5-6

products-and-services.text_he: CUDA וספריות האצה מלוות את פלטפורמות ה־GPU; אנבידיה מוכרת גם תקשורת ותוכנה ארגונית. הודעת אוגוסט מדווחת על עלייה לייצור מלא של Vera Rubin.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Direct buyers include distributors, OEMs, cloud providers and model makers. Revenue concentration among direct customers does not identify the ultimate users of their systems.

evidence.locator: Note 13, Segment Information / direct and indirect customers, p. 23

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: הקונים הישירים כוללים מפיצים, יצרני ציוד, ספקי ענן ויצרני מודלים. ריכוזיות הכנסות אצל לקוחות ישירים אינה מזהה בהכרח את המשתמשים הסופיים.

industry-and-value-chain.text: NVIDIA uses outsourced manufacturing. Its annual report identifies TSMC and Samsung as foundries and Micron, SK hynix and Samsung as memory suppliers.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Manufacturing, p. 8

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: אנבידיה משתמשת בייצור חיצוני. הדוח השנתי מציין את TSMC ואת Samsung כיצרניות שבבים ואת Micron, SK hynix ו־Samsung כספקיות זיכרון.

competitive-landscape.text: AMD and Intel compete in accelerated computing; large cloud customers also design substitutes internally. Broadcom appears among networking competitors. Competition differs by product rather than mapping neatly to one sector list.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition, pp. 8-9

competitive-landscape.text_he: AMD ו־Intel מתחרות במחשוב מואץ; לקוחות ענן גדולים מפתחים גם חלופות פנימיות. Broadcom מופיעה בין מתחרות התקשורת. התחרות משתנה לפי מוצר ואינה זהה לרשימת חברות בענף.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: software compatibility and system integration can reinforce adoption of successive NVIDIA platforms. They do not eliminate customer incentives to develop custom accelerators or negotiate price.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Our Company and Competition

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: תאימות תוכנה ושילוב מערכות עשויים לחזק אימוץ של דורות פלטפורמה עוקבים. הם אינם מבטלים תמריצים של לקוחות לפתח מאיצים ייעודיים או לנהל משא ומתן על מחיר.

growth-drivers.text: Management links growth to AI training, inference and emerging agent workloads. Its August outlook assumes no China Data Center compute revenue, emphasizing that geographic access is a constraint.

evidence.locator: CEO commentary and Outlook

growth-drivers.text_he: ההנהלה קושרת צמיחה לאימון, הסקה ועומסי סוכני AI. תחזית אוגוסט מניחה אפס הכנסות מחשוב Data Center מסין, ומדגישה את מגבלת הגישה הגאוגרפית.

financial-performance.text: For Q2 FY2027 ended July 26, 2026, GAAP revenue was USD 96,221 million, operating income USD 63,734 million and net income USD 59,688 million.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income, p. 3

financial-performance.text_he: ברבעון Q2 של FY2027 שהסתיים ב־26 ביולי 2026 הכנסות GAAP היו 96,221 מיליון דולר, הרווח התפעולי 63,734 מיליון והרווח הנקי 59,688 מיליון.

financial-performance.text: Q2 FY2027 GAAP operating cash flow was USD 24,077 million for the quarter ended July 26, 2026, versus USD 50,344 million in Q1 ended April 26, 2026. The CFO attributed the sequential decline to higher working-capital adjustments and cash taxes. These are quarterly cash flows, not the six-month cumulative figure.

evidence.locator: Balance Sheet and Cash Flow; Reconciliation of GAAP to Non-GAAP Financial Measures / quarterly operating cash flow columns
Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows; MD&A, Liquidity and Capital Resources

financial-performance.text_he: תזרים GAAP מפעילות שוטפת ב־Q2 של FY2027 היה 24,077 מיליון דולר ברבעון שהסתיים ב־26 ביולי 2026, לעומת 50,344 מיליון דולר ב־Q1 שהסתיים ב־26 באפריל 2026. סמנכ״לית הכספים ייחסה את הירידה לעומת הרבעון הקודם להתאמות הון חוזר גבוהות יותר ולמסים ששולמו במזומן. אלה תזרימים רבעוניים ולא הנתון המצטבר לחצי שנה.

financial-performance.text: Q2 FY2027 GAAP income includes USD 7,771 million of net equity-securities gains. NVIDIA reports non-GAAP net income of USD 53,954 million after excluding these gains and applying other adjustments and related taxes. Beginning in Q1 FY2027, its non-GAAP measures include stock compensation; the comparative non-GAAP periods presented were recast on that basis.

evidence.locator: Non-GAAP Measures; Reconciliation / gains from equity securities, net and non-GAAP net income
Note 7, Other Income, Net

financial-performance.text_he: רווחי GAAP עבור Q2 של FY2027 כוללים רווחים נטו של 7,771 מיליון דולר מניירות ערך הוניים. אנבידיה מדווחת על רווח נקי non-GAAP של 53,954 מיליון דולר לאחר נטרול רווחים אלה וביצוע התאמות אחרות והתאמות מס קשורות. החל מ־Q1 של FY2027 מדדי non-GAAP שלה כוללים תגמול הוני; תקופות ההשוואה שהוצגו לפי non-GAAP הוצגו מחדש על אותו בסיס.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At July 26, 2026, GAAP cash and equivalents were USD 22,443 million, separate from marketable investments. The subsequently announced Hugging Face acquisition remains conditional and should not be treated as completed.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets, p. 5
Item 8.01, proposed acquisition and closing conditions

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־26 ביולי 2026 מזומנים ושווי מזומנים לפי GAAP היו 22,443 מיליון דולר, בנפרד מהשקעות סחירות. רכישת Hugging Face שהוכרזה לאחר מכן עדיין מותנית ואין להתייחס אליה כעסקה שהושלמה.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At July 26, 2026, net accounts receivable were USD 63,059 million. The CFO reported days sales outstanding of 60 days, up from 45 days in the preceding quarter, due to extended payment terms on large multi-quarter agreements with certain investment-grade customers. Longer collection terms alone do not establish a credit loss.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets / Accounts receivable, net; Note 7, customer payment terms
Balance Sheet and Cash Flow / accounts receivable and DSO

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־26 ביולי 2026 יתרת הלקוחות נטו הייתה 63,059 מיליון דולר. סמנכ״לית הכספים דיווחה על 60 ימי גבייה, לעומת 45 ימים ברבעון הקודם, בשל הארכת תנאי תשלום בהסכמים גדולים למספר רבעונים עם לקוחות מסוימים בדירוג השקעה. תקופות גבייה ארוכות יותר אינן כשלעצמן הוכחה להפסד אשראי.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: Supply and capacity commitments were USD 279 billion at July 26, 2026, versus USD 119 billion in the previous quarter, primarily for memory and manufacturing capacity. Some supplier arrangements may be cancelled, rescheduled or adjusted before firm orders, potentially at additional cost. The commitments are future procurement obligations, not current debt or customer revenue backlog.

evidence.locator: Note 10, Commitments / Supply and capacity
Commitments / supply and capacity

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: התחייבויות האספקה והקיבולת הסתכמו ב־279 מיליארד דולר ב־26 ביולי 2026, לעומת 119 מיליארד דולר ברבעון הקודם, בעיקר לזיכרון ולקיבולת ייצור. ניתן לבטל, לדחות או להתאים חלק מהסדרי הספקים לפני הזמנות מחייבות, לעיתים בעלות נוספת. אלה התחייבויות רכש עתידיות ולא חוב נוכחי או צבר הכנסות מלקוחות.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: The August 2026 SB Energy guarantees cap NVIDIA credit support at USD 105 billion for an OpenAI affiliate. Including existing AI-cloud guarantees of USD 3.5 billion, disclosed maximum gross exposure is USD 108.5 billion. Payment depends on specified tenant defaults; guarantees activate as the relevant leases commence and their exposure declines with lease payments. Maximum exposure is not current debt, an expected loss or recognized revenue.

evidence.locator: Note 10, Additional Commitments and Guarantees / SB Energy and maximum gross exposure table
Guarantees

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ערבויות SB Energy מאוגוסט 2026 מגבילות את תמיכת האשראי של אנבידיה ל־105 מיליארד דולר עבור חברה הקשורה ל־OpenAI. בצירוף ערבויות קיימות לחברות ענן AI בסך 3.5 מיליארד דולר, החשיפה המרבית ברוטו שדווחה היא 108.5 מיליארד דולר. תשלום מותנה במקרי כשל מוגדרים של השוכר; הערבויות נכנסות לתוקף עם תחילת חוזי השכירות הרלוונטיים והחשיפה פוחתת עם תשלומי השכירות. החשיפה המרבית אינה חוב נוכחי, הפסד צפוי או הכנסה שהוכרה.

management-and-governance.text: The August 26 results identify Jensen Huang as founder and CEO and Colette Kress as executive vice president and CFO. Ownership and compensation have not been reviewed.

evidence.locator: CEO commentary; CFO commentary and conference-call information

management-and-governance.text_he: בתוצאות מ־26 באוגוסט Jensen Huang מצוין כמייסד ומנכ״ל ו־Colette Kress כסגנית נשיא בכירה וסמנכ״לית כספים. בעלות ותגמול לא נבדקו.

catalysts.text: NVIDIA expects the Hugging Face transaction to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Approval and integration remain uncertain.

evidence.locator: Item 8.01, expected closing

catalysts.text_he: אנבידיה צופה השלמת עסקת Hugging Face במחצית הראשונה של 2027, בכפוף לתנאים מקובלים ולאישורים רגולטוריים. האישור והאינטגרציה עדיין אינם ודאיים.

catalysts.text: As disclosed on August 26, 2026, management expects the first SB Energy phase in FY2029, subject to construction and ready-for-service conditions. The CFO commentary describes potential revenue from future infrastructure generations; those opportunities are forward-looking and are not realized revenue or a contracted sales schedule.

evidence.locator: Guarantees and forward-looking statements
Note 10, SB Energy guarantees; MD&A, Data Center Infrastructure

catalysts.text_he: לפי גילוי 26 באוגוסט 2026, ההנהלה מצפה לשלב הראשון של SB Energy ב־FY2029, בכפוף לתנאי בנייה ומוכנות לשירות. דברי סמנכ״לית הכספים מתארים הכנסות אפשריות מדורות תשתית עתידיים; הזדמנויות אלה צופות פני עתיד ואינן הכנסה שהתממשה או לוח מכירות מחייב.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Interpretation: use the Q2 FY2027 receivables, collection days and quarterly operating cash flow as monitoring baselines. Collection days rising further while cash generation fails to recover, unused supply commitments increasing, delayed customer deployments or a tenant default that calls a guarantee would weaken the growth and funding thesis. Extended terms for investment-grade customers are not by themselves evidence of impairment; track actual collections and guarantee utilization.

evidence.locator: Item 1A, commitments, guarantees, counterparty and execution risks; Note 7, payment terms; Note 10, commitments
Balance Sheet and Cash Flow; Commitments; Guarantees

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: פרשנות: יש להשתמש ביתרות הלקוחות, בימי הגבייה ובתזרים הרבעוני מפעילות שוטפת של Q2 ב־FY2027 כבסיס למעקב. עלייה נוספת בימי הגבייה ללא התאוששות ביצירת המזומנים, גידול בהתחייבויות אספקה שאינן מנוצלות, עיכוב בפריסות לקוחות או כשל של שוכר שמפעיל ערבות יחלישו את תזת הצמיחה והמימון. תנאי תשלום מוארכים ללקוחות בדירוג השקעה אינם כשלעצמם ראיה לירידת ערך; יש לעקוב אחר הגבייה בפועל ומימוש הערבויות.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Interpretation: bull requires sustained deployment of new platforms; base assumes orderly transitions; bear combines customer delays and competing accelerators. Investigate deployment economics and repeat demand rather than treating announced capacity as realized revenue.

evidence.locator: Highlights and Cautionary Statement

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: פרשנות: בחיובי נמשכת פריסת פלטפורמות חדשות; בבסיסי המעבר בין דורות מסודר; בשלילי משתלבים עיכובי לקוחות ומאיצים מתחרים. יש לבדוק כלכלת פריסה וביקוש חוזר, בלי לראות בקיבולת מוכרזת הכנסה ממומשת.

relationships-and-themes.text: Hugging Face is a proposed acquisition target, not yet a subsidiary in this packet. NVIDIA commits to an open platform supporting other silicon vendors if the transaction completes.

evidence.locator: Item 8.01, open-platform commitment

relationships-and-themes.text_he: Hugging Face היא יעד רכישה מוצע וטרם חברה בת במחקר זה. אנבידיה מתחייבת לפלטפורמה פתוחה התומכת גם בספקי שבבים אחרים אם העסקה תושלם.

recent-developments.text: NVIDIA signed the Hugging Face agreement on September 2 and disclosed it September 3, 2026. This extends the research focus from hardware deployment to model-development tooling and acquisition execution.

evidence.locator: Item 8.01, agreement date and description

recent-developments.text_he: אנבידיה חתמה על הסכם Hugging Face ב־2 בספטמבר ודיווחה עליו ב־3 בספטמבר 2026. האירוע מרחיב את מוקד המחקר מפריסת חומרה לכלי פיתוח מודלים ולביצוע הרכישה.

gaps.en: Independent human review remains outstanding; this packet has received a Codex AI claim-level source review.
gaps.he: טרם נערכה ביקורת אנושית עצמאית. הטענות עברו בדיקת מקורות באמצעות Codex AI.

gaps.en: SEC inventory was checked through 2026-10-18, including the post-earnings September 3 filing; this is not exhaustive monitoring of all investor announcements.
gaps.he: רשימת SEC נבדקה עד 2026-10-18, כולל דיווח 3 בספטמבר לאחר התוצאות; זה אינו מעקב ממצה אחר הודעות משקיעים.

gaps.en: No current valuation, ownership analysis, complete debt reconciliation or independent product benchmark is included.
gaps.he: אין תמחור נוכחי, ניתוח בעלות, התאמת חוב מלאה או בדיקת ביצועי מוצרים עצמאית.

gaps.en: Platform adoption, direct-customer concentration and ultimate end-user economics need deeper analysis.
gaps.he: אימוץ פלטפורמות, ריכוזיות לקוחות ישירים וכלכלת משתמשים סופיים דורשים העמקה.

gaps.en: The August CFO commentary was added in an incremental AI review on 2026-10-19. The evidence cutoff remains 2026-10-18. Guarantee fair values, counterparty default probabilities and revenue from future infrastructure cycles are not independently estimated; other issuer announcements remain pending.
gaps.he: דברי סמנכ״לית הכספים מאוגוסט נוספו בבדיקה משלימה של AI ב־2026-10-19. מועד חתך הראיות נותר 2026-10-18. לא נאמדו עצמאית השווי ההוגן של הערבויות, הסתברויות כשל של צדדים נגדיים או הכנסות ממחזורי תשתית עתידיים; הודעות חברה אחרות עדיין ממתינות לבדיקה.

SEC-0001045810-25-000023.source_name: NVDA annual report: retrospective ten-for-one stock split disclosure

us-gaap:Revenues.label: Revenues
us-gaap:Revenues.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.label: Cost of Revenue
us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAsset.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAsset.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DebtCurrent.label: Debt, Current
us-gaap:DebtCurrent.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

limitations: Company Facts excludes custom taxonomy and dimensional/segment facts; absent data is not zero.
Company Facts does not carry the full filing context. Revisions may reflect restatements, stock splits, scope changes or tagging differences; flagged revisions are not automatically reconciled.
Fiscal labels come from primary filing focus and annual boundaries; SEC calendar frames are retained only as provenance.
Standalone quarters derived from cumulative values use exact matching fiscal starts/tags/units; cross-filing inputs are disclosed. EPS and weighted-average shares are never subtracted.

Debt lease coverage, short-term borrowings, principal versus carrying value, and unverified share cells require filing-level review before valuation. Explicit split and scope reviews cover exact approved observations only. Weighted-average diluted shares and period-end outstanding shares are separate concepts, and neither is a current quote-date share count.
Cash excludes marketable securities unless independently presented as short_term_investments. Cash plus investments is not assumed to be unrestricted cash.
This is a selected historical metric schedule, not complete statements, a three-statement model, consensus, forecasts or a valuation.
Full balance-sheet and cash-flow reconciliations are outside the selected metric scope and have not been performed.

scenarios.label: Bear
scenarios.rationale: A strong FY2027 ramp is followed by a hyperscaler spending pause, customer concentration losses, competing accelerators, or tighter export access. Mix and pricing erode margins; stock compensation exceeds buybacks and the multiple contracts.
scenarios.rationale_he: הזינוק ב-FY2027 מתחלף בהפסקת השקעות אצל לקוחות ענן, אובדן לקוח מרכזי, תחרות ממאיצים חלופיים או מגבלות יצוא. תמהיל ומחירים שוחקים מרווחים; הדילול גדל והמכפיל מתכווץ.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A lower earnings multiple reflects weaker durability and higher risk.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.rationale: Accelerated-computing demand stays strong but growth decelerates after the FY2027 ramp. No incremental China reopening is required. Competition and systems mix gradually reduce profit margins; net repurchases modestly reduce annual diluted shares.
scenarios.rationale_he: הביקוש למחשוב מואץ נשאר חזק, אך הצמיחה מאטה אחרי FY2027. התרחיש אינו דורש פתיחה מחודשת של השוק הסיני. תחרות ותמהיל מערכות מורידים בהדרגה את הרווחיות, ורכישות עצמיות מקטינות מעט את מספר המניות המדולל.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A selected mid-case earnings multiple, not a market consensus or peer-derived target.

scenarios.label: Bull
scenarios.rationale: AI infrastructure demand broadens beyond the largest buyers and product transitions execute well. Pricing power, networking attachment and software maintain high margins. Sustained cash conversion and repurchases must justify the premium exit multiple.
scenarios.rationale_he: הביקוש לתשתיות AI מתרחב מעבר ללקוחות הגדולים, ומעברי הדורות מצליחים. כוח תמחור, תקשורת ותוכנה שומרים על מרווחים גבוהים. תזרים ורכישות עצמיות לאורך זמן צריכים להצדיק את המכפיל הגבוה.
scenarios.exit_multiple_rationale: A premium earnings multiple requires durable growth and cash conversion.

business-overview.text: AMD designs processors, accelerators and adaptive-computing products sold into data centers, PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Manufacturing relies on external foundries.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Business and Manufacturing Arrangements

business-overview.text_he: AMD מתכננת מעבדים, מאיצים ומוצרי מחשוב מסתגל למרכזי נתונים, מחשבים אישיים, משחקים ומערכות משובצות. הייצור נשען על יצרנים חיצוניים.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: The Q2 2026 report uses Data Center, Client and Gaming, and Embedded segments. Client and Gaming are combined for segment reporting, despite separate business revenue disclosures.

evidence.locator: Note 4, Segment Reporting

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: בדוח Q2 של 2026 המגזרים הם Data Center, Client and Gaming ו־Embedded. Client and Gaming משולבים לצורכי דיווח מגזרי, למרות הצגת הכנסות עסקיות בנפרד.

products-and-services.text: Core families include EPYC server CPUs, Instinct accelerators, Ryzen PC processors, Radeon graphics and adaptive SoCs/FPGAs. Software tools support deployment and programmability.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Products; Design Platforms and Services

products-and-services.text_he: משפחות הליבה כוללות מעבדי שרת EPYC, מאיצי Instinct, מעבדי Ryzen, גרפיקת Radeon ומערכות SoC ו־FPGA מסתגלות. כלי תוכנה תומכים בפריסה ובתכנות.

customers-and-end-markets.text: AMD sells through OEMs, hyperscalers, distributors and system integrators. Certain customers pay engineering fees for design and development and purchase the resulting chips.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Sales and Marketing; Customers

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: AMD מוכרת דרך יצרני ציוד, ענקיות ענן, מפיצים ואינטגרטורים. לקוחות מסוימים משלמים דמי הנדסה על תכנון ופיתוח ורוכשים את השבבים שנוצרים.

industry-and-value-chain.text: TSMC supplies wafers for high-performance and adaptive products; GlobalFoundries supplies specified older process nodes. Product execution therefore depends on both design and outsourced capacity.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Third-Party Wafer Foundry Facilities

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: TSMC מספקת פרוסות למוצרים עתירי ביצועים ולמוצרים מסתגלים; GlobalFoundries מספקת תהליכי ייצור ותיקים מסוימים. הביצוע תלוי גם בתכנון וגם בקיבולת חיצונית.

competitive-landscape.text: Intel competes in CPUs; NVIDIA competes in GPUs and data-center acceleration. Customer-designed processors and accelerators also constrain the addressable market.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition in Data Center and Client and Gaming

competitive-landscape.text_he: Intel מתחרה במעבדים מרכזיים ו־NVIDIA בגרפיקה ובהאצת מרכזי נתונים. מעבדים ומאיצים בתכנון הלקוחות עצמם מגבילים גם הם את השוק הנגיש.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: a broad compute portfolio and software support can aid system adoption, but competitiveness requires timely launches, power efficiency and customer qualification. Portfolio breadth alone does not prove pricing power.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition and Research and Development

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: סל מחשוב רחב ותמיכת תוכנה עשויים לסייע באימוץ מערכות, אך נדרשים השקות בזמן, יעילות אנרגטית והסמכת לקוחות. רוחב הסל לבדו אינו מוכיח כוח תמחור.

growth-drivers.text: Management expects EPYC demand, Instinct deployments and the Helios ramp to support second-half 2026 growth. These are management expectations, not a committed revenue schedule.

evidence.locator: Opening CEO/CFO commentary

growth-drivers.text_he: ההנהלה צופה שביקוש ל־EPYC, פריסת Instinct ועליית Helios יתמכו בצמיחה במחצית השנייה של 2026. אלה ציפיות הנהלה ולא לוח הכנסות מובטח.

financial-performance.text: For Q2 2026 ended June 27, GAAP revenue was USD 11,536 million, operating income USD 1,990 million and net income USD 2,297 million. Prior-year comparisons require considering the MI308 export-control inventory charge.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations; MD&A Executive Summary

financial-performance.text_he: ברבעון Q2 של 2026 שהסתיים ב־27 ביוני הכנסות GAAP היו 11,536 מיליון דולר, הרווח התפעולי 1,990 מיליון והרווח הנקי 2,297 מיליון. בהשוואה לשנה הקודמת יש להביא בחשבון חיוב מלאי MI308 בעקבות מגבלות יצוא.

financial-performance.text: On August 4, 2026, AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to approximately USD 13 billion, plus or minus USD 300 million. It guided non-GAAP gross margin to approximately 56%, operating expenses to approximately USD 3.65 billion, other income net of interest expense to approximately USD 55 million, and an effective tax rate of 13%. Except revenue, these outlook measures are non-GAAP; they are dated management expectations, not reported Q3 results.

evidence.locator: Slide 17, Financial Outlook – NON-GAAP; slide 2, Cautionary Statement

financial-performance.text_he: ב־4 באוגוסט 2026 AMD חזתה עבור Q3 של 2026 הכנסות של כ־13 מיליארד דולר, בטווח של פלוס או מינוס 300 מיליון דולר. תחזית non-GAAP כללה שיעור רווח גולמי של כ־56%, הוצאות תפעוליות של כ־3.65 מיליארד דולר, הכנסות אחרות נטו לאחר הוצאות ריבית של כ־55 מיליון דולר ושיעור מס אפקטיבי של 13%. מלבד ההכנסות, מדדי התחזית הם לפי non-GAAP; אלה ציפיות הנהלה מתוארכות ולא תוצאות Q3 מדווחות.

financial-performance.text: Q2 2026 GAAP earnings include USD 483 million of net gains on long-term investments. The earnings reconciliation removes these gains when presenting non-GAAP income and separately adjusts stock compensation, acquired-intangible amortization, other costs and taxes. GAAP net income and the adjusted outlook therefore use different accounting bases.

MD&A, Other Income (Expense), Net; Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows

financial-performance.text_he: רווחי GAAP עבור Q2 של 2026 כוללים רווחים נטו של 483 מיליון דולר מהשקעות לטווח ארוך. ההתאמה לרווח non-GAAP מנטרלת רווחים אלה ומבצעת בנפרד התאמות לתגמול הוני, להפחתת נכסים בלתי מוחשיים שנרכשו, לעלויות אחרות ולמסים. לכן הרווח הנקי לפי GAAP והתחזית המתואמת משתמשים בבסיסים חשבונאיים שונים.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: AMD completed a senior-note offering on August 17, 2026, after the quarter-end balance sheet. In September it agreed to acquire World Labs using shares, so quarter-end debt and share counts are insufficient for a current capitalization.

evidence.locator: Item 1.01, completed offering and use of proceeds
Item 3.02, consideration and share-pricing mechanism

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: AMD השלימה הנפקת אג״ח בכירות ב־17 באוגוסט 2026, לאחר תאריך המאזן הרבעוני. בספטמבר הסכימה לרכוש את World Labs במניות, ולכן חוב ומספר מניות מסוף הרבעון אינם מספיקים למבנה הון עדכני.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: The August 4, 2026 presentation estimates Q3 2026 diluted weighted-average shares at 1,661 million for GAAP and non-GAAP EPS. The employee-equity dilution estimate uses an average stock price of USD 534 from June 29 through July 24, 2026. That historical assumption is not a current stock quote, and the estimate predates the World Labs acquisition agreement.

evidence.locator: Slide 25, Share Count Overview and footnotes
Item 3.02, September acquisition agreement and undetermined closing share count

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: מצגת 4 באוגוסט 2026 מעריכה את ממוצע המניות המשוקלל בדילול מלא עבור Q3 של 2026 ב־1,661 מיליון, לצורך EPS לפי GAAP ולפי non-GAAP. אומדן הדילול מתגמול הוני לעובדים משתמש במחיר מניה ממוצע של 534 דולר בין 29 ביוני ל־24 ביולי 2026. הנחה היסטורית זו אינה מחיר מניה נוכחי, והאומדן קדם להסכם רכישת World Labs.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At June 27, 2026, AMD reported approximately USD 30.3 billion of unconditional commitments, including USD 17.4 billion for the remainder of fiscal 2026, and data-center lease guarantees with maximum potential future payments of USD 4.1 billion. Purchase commitments and contingent guarantees are funding exposures, not customer revenue backlog.

evidence.locator: MD&A, Financial Condition / contractual obligations, purchase commitments and data-center lease guarantees

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־27 ביוני 2026 AMD דיווחה על התחייבויות בלתי מותנות של כ־30.3 מיליארד דולר, מהן 17.4 מיליארד דולר ליתרת שנת הכספים 2026, ועל ערבויות לשכירת מרכזי נתונים עם תשלומים עתידיים אפשריים מרביים של 4.1 מיליארד דולר. התחייבויות רכישה וערבויות מותנות הן חשיפות מימון, ולא צבר הכנסות מלקוחות.

management-and-governance.text: The earnings release names Lisa Su as chair/CEO and Jean Hu as CFO. The August 19 board change appointed Tim Ryan and made KC McClure chair of Audit and Finance.

evidence.locator: Opening management commentary
Item 5.02, Director Retirement and Director Appointment

management-and-governance.text_he: הודעת התוצאות מציינת את Lisa Su כיו״ר ומנכ״לית ואת Jean Hu כסמנכ״לית כספים. שינוי הדירקטוריון מ־19 באוגוסט מינה את Tim Ryan והעביר ל־KC McClure את ראשות ועדת הביקורת והכספים.

catalysts.text: Interpretation: compare the next reported Q3 2026 revenue, non-GAAP gross margin and operating expenses with the dated August outlook, and reconcile differences to Helios deployment, Instinct shipments and Data Center growth. A missed outlook alongside delayed deployments warrants a thesis review. Product announcements alone do not establish recognized revenue.

evidence.locator: CEO commentary and Recent Highlights
Slides 14 and 17, Data Center and Financial Outlook

catalysts.text_he: פרשנות: יש להשוות את ההכנסות וכן את שיעור הרווח הגולמי וההוצאות התפעוליות לפי non-GAAP שידווחו עבור Q3 של 2026 לתחזית המתוארכת מאוגוסט, ולברר את הפערים לפי פריסת Helios, משלוחי Instinct וצמיחת Data Center. החמצת התחזית לצד עיכובי פריסה מחייבת בחינה מחדש של התזה. הכרזות על מוצרים אינן מוכיחות הכנסה שהוכרה.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Interpretation: the growth thesis weakens if export restrictions, memory shortages or qualification delays prevent the expected accelerator ramp while unconditional purchase commitments remain. Monitor the reported commitment schedule, cash generation and acquisition dilution alongside the dated revenue and margin outlook; persistent execution misses or funding needs unsupported by operating cash flow require reassessment.

evidence.locator: MD&A, Financial Condition and Risk Factors / supplier dependence and export restrictions
Slides 2 and 17, Cautionary Statement and Financial Outlook
Item 3.02, stock consideration

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: פרשנות: תזת הצמיחה נחלשת אם מגבלות יצוא, מחסור בזיכרון או עיכובי הסמכת לקוחות מונעים את העלייה הצפויה בפעילות המאיצים בעוד התחייבויות הרכישה הבלתי מותנות נותרות. יש לעקוב אחר לוח ההתחייבויות, יצירת המזומנים ודילול הרכישה לצד תחזית ההכנסות והרווחיות המתוארכת; החמצות ביצוע מתמשכות או צורכי מימון שאינם נתמכים בתזרים מפעילות שוטפת מחייבים הערכה מחדש.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Interpretation: bull assumes successful accelerator scaling; base assumes product ramps with mixed end markets; bear assumes export restrictions and competitive displacement. Validate software readiness and customer economics before quantifying these scenarios.

evidence.locator: Management commentary and Cautionary Statement

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: פרשנות: בחיובי המאיצים מתרחבים בהצלחה; בבסיסי השקות מתקדמות לצד שווקי קצה מעורבים; בשלילי מגבלות יצוא ותחרות דוחקות מוצרים. לפני כימות יש לאמת מוכנות תוכנה וכלכלת לקוחות.

relationships-and-themes.text: World Labs is a proposed acquisition counterparty. The September filing describes share consideration with the share count determined near closing; it does not establish that the acquisition has closed.

evidence.locator: Item 3.02, Merger Agreement and share-pricing terms

relationships-and-themes.text_he: World Labs היא צד לעסקת רכישה מוצעת. דיווח ספטמבר מתאר תמורה במניות שמספרן ייקבע סמוך לסגירה; הוא אינו קובע שהרכישה הושלמה.

recent-developments.text: The World Labs agreement was signed September 26 and disclosed September 28, 2026. Separately, the February 4 annual-report amendment corrected transposed Client ASP and unit-growth disclosures; use the amended MD&A for historical comparisons.

evidence.locator: Item 3.02 and signature date
Explanatory Note

recent-developments.text_he: הסכם World Labs נחתם ב־26 בספטמבר ודווח ב־28 בספטמבר 2026. בנפרד, תיקון הדוח השנתי מ־4 בפברואר תיקן החלפה בין נתוני צמיחת מחיר מכירה ממוצע וצמיחת יחידות ב־Client; להשוואות היסטוריות יש להשתמש בדיון ההנהלה המתוקן.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments.label: Short-term Investments
us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments.description: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:ShortTermBorrowings.label: Short-term Debt
us-gaap:ShortTermBorrowings.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

qa_flags.impact: Per-share and share-count histories require a corporate-action review before valuation or cross-period modeling.
Debt amounts must be reconciled for lease coverage, complete borrowing scope and carrying value before an enterprise-value bridge.
Missing cells are not zero; source the relevant filing and exact definition before modeling.

limitations: Company Facts excludes custom taxonomy and dimensional/segment facts; absent data is not zero.
Company Facts does not carry the full filing context. Revisions may reflect restatements, stock splits, scope changes or tagging differences; flagged revisions are not automatically reconciled.
Fiscal labels come from primary filing focus and annual boundaries; SEC calendar frames are retained only as provenance.
Standalone quarters derived from cumulative values use exact matching fiscal starts/tags/units; cross-filing inputs are disclosed. EPS and weighted-average shares are never subtracted.

Debt lease coverage, short-term borrowings, principal versus carrying value, and unverified share cells require filing-level review before valuation. Explicit split and scope reviews cover exact approved observations only. Weighted-average diluted shares and period-end outstanding shares are separate concepts, and neither is a current quote-date share count.
Cash excludes marketable securities unless independently presented as short_term_investments. Cash plus investments is not assumed to be unrestricted cash.
This is a selected historical metric schedule, not complete statements, a three-statement model, consensus, forecasts or a valuation.
Full balance-sheet and cash-flow reconciliations are outside the selected metric scope and have not been performed.

business-overview.text: Broadcom supplies semiconductors and infrastructure software. Its portfolio connects AI and communications hardware with enterprise virtualization, security and mainframe software.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Business / semiconductor and infrastructure software portfolios

business-overview.text_he: ברודקום מספקת מוליכים למחצה ותוכנת תשתית. סל המוצרים מחבר חומרת AI ותקשורת עם וירטואליזציה ארגונית, אבטחה ותוכנת מיינפריים.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: The segments are Semiconductor Solutions and Infrastructure Software. Some software license revenue is recognized upfront, so software revenue should not automatically be equated with recurring subscription revenue.

evidence.locator: Note 2, Revenue from Contracts with Customers; Note 9, Segment Information

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: המגזרים הם Semiconductor Solutions ו־Infrastructure Software. חלק מהכנסות רישיונות התוכנה מוכרות מראש, ולכן אין להשוות אוטומטית הכנסות תוכנה להכנסות מינויים חוזרות.

products-and-services.text: Offerings include custom accelerators, networking chips and wireless components, plus VMware Cloud Foundation, mainframe tools and security software. Product exposure spans multiple purchasing cycles.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Products / Infrastructure Software portfolio

products-and-services.text_he: המוצרים כוללים מאיצים מותאמים, שבבי תקשורת ורכיבים אלחוטיים, וכן VMware Cloud Foundation, כלי מיינפריים ואבטחה. המוצרים חשופים למחזורי רכישה שונים.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Semiconductor distribution includes OEMs, contract manufacturers and distributors. Software buyers include large enterprises with complex IT systems. End-customer concentration can differ from invoiced distributor concentration.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Customers, Sales and Distribution

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: הפצת השבבים כוללת יצרני ציוד, יצרנים בקבלנות ומפיצים. רוכשי התוכנה כוללים ארגונים גדולים בעלי מערכות IT מורכבות. ריכוזיות אצל לקוח סופי עשויה להיות שונה מזו של המפיץ המחויב בחשבונית.

industry-and-value-chain.text: Broadcom outsources most manufacturing, including wafer production to TSMC, while retaining proprietary-process capabilities such as wireless filters. This combination preserves some manufacturing IP but leaves external capacity dependencies.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Manufacturing

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: ברודקום מוציאה את רוב הייצור החוצה, כולל פרוסות אצל TSMC, ושומרת על יכולות בתהליכים קנייניים כגון מסננים אלחוטיים. הדבר משמר קניין רוחני מסוים בייצור לצד תלות בקיבולת חיצונית.

competitive-landscape.text: NVIDIA explicitly lists Broadcom among its networking competitors. This is a product-specific overlap; Broadcom also faces separate competition in enterprise software and custom silicon.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition / networking products
Item 1, Competition

competitive-landscape.text_he: NVIDIA מציינת במפורש את ברודקום כמתחרה בתקשורת. זו חפיפה ברמת מוצר; לברודקום תחרות נפרדת גם בתוכנה ארגונית ובשבבים מותאמים.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: customer co-design and software embedded in critical systems can support retention. Switching costs and engineering integration require evidence by product; acquisitions and portfolio breadth are not sufficient proof.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Research and Development; Customers, Sales and Distribution

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: תכנון משותף עם לקוחות ותוכנה המוטמעת במערכות קריטיות עשויים לתמוך בשימור. יש לבדוק עלויות מעבר ואינטגרציה בכל מוצר; רכישות ורוחב סל אינם הוכחה מספקת.

growth-drivers.text: Management attributes AI-semiconductor demand to custom accelerators and networking. Its next-quarter outlook assumes continued growth; actual shipments depend on customer programs and deployment timing.

evidence.locator: CEO commentary and Fourth Quarter Business Outlook

growth-drivers.text_he: ההנהלה מייחסת ביקוש לשבבי AI למאיצים מותאמים ולתקשורת. תחזית הרבעון הבא מניחה המשך צמיחה; המשלוחים בפועל תלויים בתוכניות לקוחות ובמועדי פריסה.

financial-performance.text: For Q3 FY2026 ended August 2, GAAP revenue was USD 29,591 million, operating income USD 15,955 million and net income USD 13,088 million. The adjusted figures in the earnings release exclude material categories of expense.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, p. 3
Non-GAAP Financial Measures

financial-performance.text_he: ברבעון Q3 של FY2026 שהסתיים ב־2 באוגוסט הכנסות GAAP היו 29,591 מיליון דולר, הרווח התפעולי 15,955 מיליון והרווח הנקי 13,088 מיליון. הנתונים המתואמים בהודעת התוצאות מחריגים קטגוריות הוצאה מהותיות.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At August 2, 2026, GAAP cash and equivalents were USD 23,975 million and debt carrying value was USD 59,419 million. Debt principal differs from carrying value because of discounts and issuance costs.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets; Note 6, Borrowings

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־2 באוגוסט 2026 מזומנים ושווי מזומנים לפי GAAP היו 23,975 מיליון דולר והערך בספרים של החוב 59,419 מיליון. קרן החוב שונה מהערך בספרים עקב ניכיונות ועלויות הנפקה.

management-and-governance.text: The September 2 results identify Hock Tan as president and CEO and Amie Thuener as CFO. Current ownership and incentive design still need proxy-level review.

evidence.locator: Opening management commentary

management-and-governance.text_he: בתוצאות מ־2 בספטמבר Hock Tan מצוין כנשיא ומנכ״ל ו־Amie Thuener כסמנכ״לית כספים. בעלות ותמריצים עדכניים עדיין דורשים בדיקת מסמכי אסיפה.

catalysts.text: Q4 FY2026 ends November 1, 2026. The next results can test the September growth outlook; the fiscal period end is not an earnings-release date or guaranteed outcome.

evidence.locator: Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Business Outlook

catalysts.text_he: רבעון Q4 של FY2026 מסתיים ב־1 בנובמבר 2026. התוצאות הבאות יאפשרו לבחון את תחזית הצמיחה מספטמבר; סוף התקופה אינו מועד פרסום תוצאות או הבטחה לתוצאה.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Custom products can be difficult to resell if customers cancel. Alternative financing arrangements add counterparty exposure. Interpretation: project delays or poor cash conversion would weaken the reported-growth thesis.

evidence.locator: Item 1A, Risk Factors / design wins, alternative financing and competition

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: מוצרים מותאמים עלולים להיות קשים למכירה ללקוח אחר בעקבות ביטול. הסדרי מימון חלופיים מוסיפים חשיפה לצד נגדי. פרשנות: עיכובי פרויקטים או המרה חלשה למזומן יחלישו את תזת הצמיחה המדווחת.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Interpretation: bull assumes successful custom-AI ramps and software retention; base assumes uneven program timing; bear combines customer concentration and deployment delays. Financing exposure and license-renewal quality need investigation before assigning probabilities.

evidence.locator: Item 1A, Risk Factors / customers, competition and software demand

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: פרשנות: בחיובי עולות תוכניות AI מותאם ונשמרים לקוחות תוכנה; בבסיסי עיתוי התוכניות אינו אחיד; בשלילי משתלבים ריכוזיות לקוחות ועיכובי פריסה. לפני הקצאת הסתברויות יש לבדוק חשיפת מימון ואיכות חידושי רישיונות.

relationships-and-themes.text: NVIDIA is a documented networking competitor; TSMC is a manufacturing supplier. These are different relationship types within AI infrastructure, not evidence that all semiconductor companies compete directly.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition / networking products
Item 1, Manufacturing

relationships-and-themes.text_he: NVIDIA היא מתחרת תקשורת מתועדת ו־TSMC היא ספקית ייצור. אלה סוגי קשר שונים בתשתיות AI, ואינם ראיה שכל חברות השבבים מתחרות ישירות זו בזו.

recent-developments.text: The September 10 quarterly filing reclassifies upfront software license revenue into products revenue and recasts comparative periods. Mix comparisons must use the recast presentation rather than treating the change as economic growth.

evidence.locator: Note 2, Reclassifications to Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations

recent-developments.text_he: הדוח הרבעוני מ־10 בספטמבר מסווג מחדש הכנסות רישיונות תוכנה מראש כהכנסות מוצרים ומציג מחדש תקופות השוואה. יש להשתמש בהצגה החדשה בהשוואת תמהיל, בלי לראות בשינוי צמיחה כלכלית.

gaps.en: Independent human review remains outstanding; this packet has received a Codex AI claim-level source review.
gaps.he: טרם נערכה ביקורת אנושית עצמאית. הטענות עברו בדיקת מקורות באמצעות Codex AI.

gaps.en: SEC inventory was checked through 2026-10-18; this packet covers the annual and latest quarterly filings and results, not every intervening issuer announcement.
gaps.he: רשימת SEC נבדקה עד 2026-10-18. המחקר מכסה דוח שנתי, דוח רבעוני ותוצאות, ולא כל הודעת חברה ביניהם.

gaps.en: No named ultimate AI customer is inferred from aggregate disclosures.
gaps.he: לא הוסק שם של לקוח AI סופי מתוך נתונים מצרפיים.

gaps.en: Software competitors, renewal economics, debt maturities, ownership and valuation require deeper work.
gaps.he: מתחרות תוכנה, כלכלת חידושים, מועדי חוב, בעלות ותמחור דורשים העמקה.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.label: Cost of Revenue
us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DebtCurrent.label: Debt, Current
us-gaap:DebtCurrent.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

business-overview.text: AeroVironment develops autonomous, precision-strike, counter-drone, space and cyber capabilities for defense customers. The latest quarter covered here ended August 1, 2026.

evidence.locator: Note 1, Organization and Significant Accounting Policies; cover page

business-overview.text_he: אירוויירונמנט מפתחת יכולות אוטונומיות, תקיפה מדויקת, הגנה מרחפנים, חלל וסייבר ללקוחות ביטחוניים. הרבעון האחרון במחקר הסתיים ב־1 באוגוסט 2026.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: The reportable segments are Autonomous Systems (AxS) and Space, Cyber and Directed Energy (SCDE). Revenue comes from hardware, support, customer-funded development and mission services, principally through fixed-price and cost-plus contracts.

evidence.locator: Item 7, Overview / Revenue

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: המגזרים המדווחים הם Autonomous Systems ‏(AxS) ו־Space, Cyber and Directed Energy ‏(SCDE). ההכנסות כוללות חומרה, תמיכה, פיתוח במימון לקוח ושירותי משימה, בעיקר בחוזי מחיר קבוע ועלות בתוספת רווח.

products-and-services.text: Examples include Puma and JUMP reconnaissance aircraft, Switchblade loitering munitions, Titan counter-drone systems and LOCUST laser systems. Product families address different missions; their technical capabilities should not be treated as interchangeable.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Autonomous Systems; Space, Cyber and Directed Energy

products-and-services.text_he: המוצרים כוללים כלי טיס לתצפית Puma ו־JUMP, חימוש משוטט Switchblade, מערכות Titan נגד רחפנים ומערכות לייזר LOCUST. משפחות המוצרים מיועדות למשימות שונות ואין להתייחס ליכולותיהן כתחליפיות.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Disclosed buyers include U.S. military services, intelligence agencies, allied governments and government subcontractors. U.S. Army purchases can include orders for other defense organizations; country exposure must therefore distinguish end users from contracting agencies.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Customers

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: הקונים המדווחים כוללים זרועות צבא אמריקאיות, גופי מודיעין, ממשלות בעלות ברית וקבלני משנה ממשלתיים. רכישות צבא היבשה האמריקאי עשויות לכלול הזמנות עבור גופים אחרים; יש להבחין בין המשתמש הסופי לגוף המתקשר.

industry-and-value-chain.text: The company combines engineering, supplier management, assembly, integration, testing and field support. Contract awards, appropriations, component availability and customer acceptance affect delivery timing.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Manufacturing and Operations; Seasonality

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: החברה משלבת הנדסה, ניהול ספקים, הרכבה, אינטגרציה, בדיקות ותמיכה בשטח. זכייה בחוזים, הקצאת תקציב, זמינות רכיבים וקבלת הלקוח משפיעות על מועד המסירה.

competitive-landscape.text: The annual report identifies Lockheed Martin and RTX among loitering-munitions and counter-drone competitors, and Anduril and Elbit among precision-strike competitors. These are company-identified competitive overlaps, not verified market-share rankings.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition

competitive-landscape.text_he: הדוח השנתי מציין את Lockheed Martin ו־RTX כמתחרות בחימוש משוטט ובהגנה מרחפנים, ואת Anduril ו־Elbit כמתחרות בתקיפה מדויקת. אלה חפיפות תחרות לפי החברה, ולא דירוגי נתח שוק מאומתים.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: integrated autonomy, installed products and field support may support repeat procurement. This does not establish a durable moat: government intellectual-property rights and rapid technology changes constrain exclusivity.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Technological Competence and Intellectual Property; Competition

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: שילוב אוטונומיה, מוצרים מותקנים ותמיכה עשוי לתמוך ברכש חוזר. אין בכך הוכחה ליתרון תחרותי עמיד: זכויות קניין רוחני ממשלתיות ושינוי טכנולוגי מהיר מגבילים בלעדיות.

growth-drivers.text: Management prioritizes manufacturing capacity and supply-chain expansion to meet autonomous-system demand. Conversion of funded orders into deliveries is the test; management commentary is not an independent demand forecast.

evidence.locator: Opening management commentary

growth-drivers.text_he: ההנהלה מתעדפת הרחבת ייצור ושרשרת אספקה כדי לענות לביקוש למערכות אוטונומיות. המבחן הוא הפיכת הזמנות ממומנות למסירות; דברי ההנהלה אינם תחזית ביקוש עצמאית.

growth-drivers.text: The latest quarter also showed Switchblade order delays and lower SCDE revenue associated with the terminated SCAR program and reduced cyber-service contract scope. Consolidated expansion should not be generalized to every product line.

evidence.locator: Item 2, Results of Operations / Revenue; SCDE Revenue

growth-drivers.text_he: ברבעון האחרון היו גם עיכובים בהזמנות Switchblade וירידה בהכנסות SCDE הקשורה לביטול SCAR ולהקטנת היקף חוזה שירותי סייבר. אין להשליך מצמיחה מאוחדת על כל קו מוצרים.

financial-performance.text: For May 1–August 1, 2026, GAAP revenue was USD 480.490 million, versus USD 454.676 million in the prior fiscal first quarter ended August 2, 2025. GAAP net loss was USD 5.066 million; GAAP diluted loss per share was USD 0.10.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, three months ended August 1, 2026 and August 2, 2025

financial-performance.text_he: בתקופה 1 במאי–1 באוגוסט 2026 הכנסות GAAP היו 480.490 מיליון דולר, לעומת 454.676 מיליון ברבעון הראשון הקודם שהסתיים ב־2 באוגוסט 2025. ההפסד הנקי לפי GAAP היה 5.066 מיליון דולר וההפסד המדולל למניה 0.10 דולר.

financial-performance.text: For that same fiscal 2027 first quarter, company-defined non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA was USD 53.4 million and adjusted diluted EPS was USD 0.59. These exclude specified expenses and are not GAAP profit or operating cash flow.

evidence.locator: Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results; Non-GAAP Measures and reconciliations

financial-performance.text_he: באותו רבעון ראשון של שנת 2027, EBITDA מתואם לפי הגדרת החברה היה 53.4 מיליון דולר והרווח המדולל המתואם למניה 0.59 דולר. מדדי non-GAAP אלה מחריגים הוצאות מסוימות ואינם רווח GAAP או תזרים מפעילות.

financial-performance.text: Calculated revenue growth for those fiscal first quarters was 5.68%. Acquisition contributions and differing product trends mean this consolidated rate is not a pure organic-growth measure.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, revenue; Item 2 Revenue in S02
Item 2, Results of Operations / Revenue

financial-performance.text_he: צמיחת ההכנסות המחושבת בין שני הרבעונים הראשונים הייתה 5.68%. תרומת רכישות ומגמות שונות בין מוצרים פירושן שאין זה שיעור צמיחה אורגנית טהור.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: At August 1, 2026, GAAP cash and equivalents were USD 278.390 million, short-term investments USD 301.837 million and long-term debt carrying value USD 730.057 million.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets; Note 9, Debt

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: ב־1 באוגוסט 2026 מזומנים ושווי מזומנים לפי GAAP היו 278.390 מיליון דולר, השקעות קצרות 301.837 מיליון והערך בספרים של החוב לטווח ארוך 730.057 מיליון.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: GAAP operating cash inflow was USD 13.496 million for May 1–August 1, 2026. Positive operating cash flow should be assessed alongside capital spending and increases in inventory and unbilled receivables.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows; Item 2, Liquidity and Capital Resources

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: תזרים GAAP מפעילות היה חיובי בסך 13.496 מיליון דולר בתקופה 1 במאי–1 באוגוסט 2026. יש לבחון אותו לצד השקעות הוניות ועליות במלאי ובחייבים שטרם חויבו.

management-and-governance.text: The August 14 proxy identifies Wahid Nawabi as chair, president and CEO, and Sean Woodward as CFO; September disclosures confirm those roles. September 24 shareholders elected the nominated directors and approved executive compensation on an advisory basis.

evidence.locator: Executive Officers, information as of August 14, 2026
Conference Call and Presentation
Item 5.07, Proposals 1 and 3

management-and-governance.text_he: מסמך האסיפה מ־14 באוגוסט מציין את Wahid Nawabi כיו״ר, נשיא ומנכ״ל ואת Sean Woodward כסמנכ״ל כספים; דיווחי ספטמבר מאשרים את התפקידים. ב־24 בספטמבר בעלי המניות בחרו בדירקטורים המועמדים ואישרו תגמול מנהלים בהצבעה מייעצת.

valuation-context.text: Interpretation: compare GAAP earnings, cash generation and reconciled adjusted EBITDA separately because acquisition amortization materially affects reported profit. No current price, enterprise value or target multiple is supplied; market valuation remains unresearched.

evidence.locator: Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results; Non-GAAP Measures

valuation-context.text_he: פרשנות: יש להשוות בנפרד רווח GAAP, יצירת מזומן ו־EBITDA מתואם שעבר התאמה, משום שהפחתות בגין רכישות משפיעות מהותית על הרווח. לא נכללו מחיר עדכני, שווי פעילות או מכפיל יעד; תמחור השוק טרם נחקר.

catalysts.text: Monitoring trigger: the next fiscal 2027 results should test backlog conversion, production expansion and the reiterated annual outlook. The fiscal year ends April 30, 2027; no date for the next earnings release was verified.

evidence.locator: Fiscal 2027 Outlook for the Full Year
Note 1, Basis of Presentation

catalysts.text_he: נקודת מעקב: תוצאות שנת 2027 הבאות צריכות לבחון המרת צבר, הרחבת ייצור והתחזית השנתית שאושרה מחדש. שנת הכספים מסתיימת ב־30 באפריל 2027; מועד פרסום התוצאות הבא לא אומת.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: The SCAR agreement was terminated for convenience in March 2026. The latest quarterly report also discloses continuing weaknesses in BlueHalo IT controls and goodwill-review controls, plus related securities litigation; allegations are not findings of liability.

evidence.locator: Item 2, Critical Accounting Policies / Goodwill; Item 4, Controls and Procedures; Part II Item 1, Legal Proceedings
Item 1A, acquisition and goodwill impairment risks

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: הסכם SCAR בוטל מטעמי נוחות במרץ 2026. הדוח הרבעוני מציין חולשות מתמשכות בבקרות IT של BlueHalo ובבקרות בדיקת מוניטין, וכן תביעות ניירות ערך קשורות; טענות בתביעה אינן קביעת אחריות.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Interpretation: upside requires profitable deliveries; downside includes order delays or impairments. Verify control remediation, organic growth and cash conversion before strengthening a thesis.

evidence.locator: Item 2, Results of Operations; Item 4, Controls and Procedures

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: פרשנות: תרחיש חיובי דורש מסירות רווחיות; השלילי כולל עיכובי הזמנות או ירידות ערך. יש לאמת תיקון בקרות, צמיחה אורגנית והמרה למזומן לפני חיזוק התזה.

relationships-and-themes.text: BlueHalo was acquired on May 1, 2025; ESAero on March 16, 2026. These are ownership relationships. Shared autonomy and counter-drone themes alone establish no commercial relationship.

evidence.locator: Note 15, Business Acquisitions / BlueHalo Acquisition; ESAero Acquisition

relationships-and-themes.text_he: BlueHalo נרכשה ב־1 במאי 2025 ו־ESAero ב־16 במרץ 2026. אלה קשרי בעלות. חשיפה משותפת לאוטונומיה ולהגנה מרחפנים כשלעצמה אינה מוכיחה קשר מסחרי.

recent-developments.text: The September 30 filing reports September 24 annual-meeting votes. This October 18 evidence cutoff covers reviewed filings, not an exhaustive announcement feed.

evidence.locator: Item 5.07, Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders

recent-developments.text_he: הדיווח מ־30 בספטמבר מתעד את הצבעות האסיפה מ־24 בספטמבר. מועד חיתוך הראיות, 18 באוקטובר, מתייחס לדיווחים שנבדקו ואינו מעקב ממצה אחר הודעות.

freshness.message: Dated research snapshot; discovery and triage do not renew its research or review date.

limitations: Provider snapshot; may be delayed. Not an exchange-certified real-time quote.
A current price does not make older financial statements current.

support_context.decision_impact: Exact reported historical metrics support research; open revisions, debt coverage and share-basis issues constrain valuation.

history.units_policy: Native SEC units: USD, shares, USD/shares; no scaling or FX conversion. Capex is negative cash outflow.
history.accounting_basis: US GAAP reported facts only; no adjusted results, forecasts or consensus.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonSt.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments.label: Short-term Investments
us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments.description: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerI.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Including Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerI.description: Amount, including tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value-added and excise.
