business-overview.text: Lockheed Martin designs, builds and sustains aerospace, missile, naval and space systems, principally for U.S. government agencies and allied governments.

evidence.locator: Item 1, General

business-overview.text_he: לוקהיד מרטין מתכננת, בונה ומתחזקת מערכות תעופה, טילים, ים וחלל, בעיקר לגופי ממשל אמריקאיים ולממשלות בעלות ברית.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: The four reporting segments are Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems, and Space. Sales include products and services.

evidence.locator: Note 3, Information on Business Segments; Consolidated Statements of Earnings

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: ארבעת מגזרי הדיווח הם Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems ו־Space. המכירות כוללות מוצרים ושירותים.

products-and-services.text: Major programs include F-35 aircraft, PAC-3 and THAAD interceptors, HIMARS launchers, Sikorsky helicopters, Aegis combat systems and Orion spacecraft.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Business Segments

products-and-services.text_he: תוכניות מרכזיות כוללות מטוסי F-35, מיירטי PAC-3 ו־THAAD, משגרי HIMARS, מסוקי Sikorsky, מערכות קרב Aegis וחלליות Orion.

customers-and-end-markets.text: U.S. military agencies and NASA are disclosed customers. International sales use both direct contracts and foreign military sales through the U.S. government.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Regulatory Matters

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: גופי הצבא האמריקאי ו־NASA הם לקוחות מדווחים. מכירות בינלאומיות כוללות חוזים ישירים ומכירות צבאיות דרך ממשלת ארצות הברית.

industry-and-value-chain.text: The prime contractor depends on specialized suppliers, scarce materials and government funding. Supplier disruption can raise costs and delay program delivery.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Raw Materials, Suppliers and Seasonality

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: הקבלן הראשי תלוי בספקים מתמחים, בחומרים נדירים ובמימון ממשלתי. הפרעות אצל ספקים עלולות להעלות עלויות ולעכב מסירות.

competitive-landscape.text: Company-identified peers include Boeing, General Dynamics, Northrop Grumman, L3Harris and RTX. A peer may compete on one program and partner on another.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition

competitive-landscape.text_he: החברה מציינת בין עמיתותיה את Boeing, General Dynamics, Northrop Grumman, L3Harris ו־RTX. חברה עשויה להתחרות בתוכנית אחת ולשתף פעולה באחרת.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: program incumbency, technical integration and sustainment capabilities support repeat work; procurement competition and government intellectual-property rights limit exclusivity.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Intellectual Property; Competition

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: מעמד בתוכנית קיימת, אינטגרציה טכנית ויכולות תחזוקה תומכים בעבודה חוזרת; תחרות ברכש וזכויות קניין רוחני של הממשלה מגבילים בלעדיות.

growth-drivers.text: The July results attributed missile growth to PAC-3, THAAD and Precision Strike Missile production increases. Continued growth requires successful manufacturing expansion.

evidence.locator: Segment Results, Missiles and Fire Control

growth-drivers.text_he: בתוצאות יולי צמיחת הטילים יוחסה להגברת ייצור PAC-3, THAAD ו־Precision Strike Missile. המשך הצמיחה דורש הרחבת ייצור מוצלחת.

financial-performance.text: For March 30–June 28, 2026, GAAP sales were USD 20,063 million, net earnings USD 1,836 million and diluted EPS USD 7.94.

evidence.locator: Consolidated Statements of Earnings, quarter ended June 28, 2026

financial-performance.text_he: בתקופה 30 במרץ–28 ביוני 2026 מכירות GAAP היו 20,063 מיליון דולר, הרווח הנקי 1,836 מיליון והרווח המדולל למניה 7.94 דולר.

financial-performance.text: Year-over-year profit comparisons benefit from the absence of large prior-year program losses. The rebound should not be treated entirely as recurring operational improvement.

evidence.locator: Consolidated Operating Profit; Net Earnings and Diluted EPS

financial-performance.text_he: השוואת הרווח לשנה הקודמת נהנית מהיעדר הפסדי תוכניות גדולים שנרשמו אז. אין לייחס את כל ההתאוששות לשיפור תפעולי חוזר.

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text: GAAP cash and equivalents were USD 3,791 million at June 28, 2026. GAAP operating cash inflow was USD 3,455 million for January 1–June 28, 2026.

evidence.locator: Consolidated Balance Sheets; Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows

balance-sheet-and-capital-allocation.text_he: מזומנים ושווי מזומנים לפי GAAP היו 3,791 מיליון דולר ב־28 ביוני 2026. תזרים GAAP מפעילות היה 3,455 מיליון בתקופה 1 בינואר–28 ביוני 2026.

management-and-governance.text: The July 23, 2026 results identify Jim Taiclet as chairman, president and CEO. Detailed compensation and ownership analysis remains outside this pilot.

evidence.locator: Opening management commentary

management-and-governance.text_he: בתוצאות מ־23 ביולי 2026 Jim Taiclet מצוין כיו״ר, נשיא ומנכ״ל. ניתוח מפורט של תגמול ובעלות אינו כלול בפיילוט.

valuation-context.text: Interpretation: evaluate cash flow and earnings after distinguishing program charges and pension adjustments. No verified current share price, multiple or fair-value estimate is included.

evidence.locator: Summary Financial Results; Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures

valuation-context.text_he: פרשנות: יש להעריך תזרים ורווח לאחר הבחנה בחיובי תוכניות ובהתאמות פנסיה. לא נכללו מחיר מניה עדכני מאומת, מכפיל או אומדן שווי הוגן.

catalysts.text: Monitoring trigger: subsequent results should test the higher July 2026 outlook and missile-production ramps. The next earnings announcement date was not sourced.

evidence.locator: 2026 Financial Outlook; Missiles and Fire Control

catalysts.text_he: נקודת מעקב: תוצאות בהמשך צריכות לבחון את התחזית שהועלתה ביולי 2026 ואת העלייה בייצור טילים. מועד הודעת התוצאות הבא לא נמצא במקור.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Concentrated exposure to F-35, complex fixed-price development and supplier performance can produce delays or losses. Repeat material program charges would weaken an execution-improvement thesis.

evidence.locator: Item 1A, F-35; estimating costs; suppliers

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: חשיפה מרוכזת ל־F-35, פיתוח מורכב במחיר קבוע וביצועי ספקים עלולים לגרום לעיכובים ולהפסדים. חיובי תוכניות מהותיים חוזרים יחלישו תזה של שיפור בביצוע.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Interpretation: upside requires profitable backlog conversion; downside includes program overruns or delayed funding. Test margin quality and working-capital needs before extrapolating the quarter.

evidence.locator: Summary Financial Results; Forward-Looking Statements

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: פרשנות: התרחיש החיובי דורש המרת צבר לרווח; השלילי כולל חריגות תוכנית או עיכובי תקציב. יש לבדוק איכות שולי רווח וצורכי הון חוזר לפני שמסיקים מהמשך הרבעון.

relationships-and-themes.text: RTX is both a named competitor and Lockheed Martin’s Javelin joint-venture partner. The Javelin relationship is specific; it does not imply cooperation across all programs.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Missiles and Fire Control / Javelin; Competition

relationships-and-themes.text_he: RTX היא גם מתחרה שצוינה וגם שותפה של לוקהיד מרטין במיזם Javelin. הקשר ספציפי למיזם ואינו מעיד על שיתוף פעולה בכל התוכניות.

recent-developments.text: On August 24, 2026, Lockheed Martin entered a replacement revolving credit agreement and extended another facility. The related filing reports no borrowing at the new facility’s closing.

evidence.locator: Item 1.01, 364-Day Revolving Credit Agreement; Extension of 5-Year Revolving Credit Agreement

recent-developments.text_he: ב־24 באוגוסט 2026 לוקהיד מרטין חתמה על הסכם אשראי מתחדש חלופי והאריכה מסגרת נוספת. הדיווח מציין שלא נמשכו הלוואות במועד סגירת המסגרת החדשה.

sources.title: Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025
Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 28, 2026
Lockheed Martin Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
Form 8-K: revolving credit agreements dated August 24, 2026

us-gaap:Revenues.label: Revenues
us-gaap:Revenues.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.label: Cost of Revenue
us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAsset.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAsset.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

qa_flags.impact: Per-share and share-count histories require a corporate-action review before valuation or cross-period modeling.
Debt amounts must be reconciled for lease coverage, complete borrowing scope and carrying value before an enterprise-value bridge.
Missing cells are not zero; source the relevant filing and exact definition before modeling.

limitations: Company Facts excludes custom taxonomy and dimensional/segment facts; absent data is not zero.
Company Facts does not carry the full filing context. Revisions may reflect restatements, stock splits, scope changes or tagging differences; flagged revisions are not automatically reconciled.
Fiscal labels come from primary filing focus and annual boundaries; SEC calendar frames are retained only as provenance.
Standalone quarters derived from cumulative values use exact matching fiscal starts/tags/units; cross-filing inputs are disclosed. EPS and weighted-average shares are never subtracted.

Debt lease coverage, short-term borrowings, principal versus carrying value, and unverified share cells require filing-level review before valuation. Explicit split and scope reviews cover exact approved observations only. Weighted-average diluted shares and period-end outstanding shares are separate concepts, and neither is a current quote-date share count.
Cash excludes marketable securities unless independently presented as short_term_investments. Cash plus investments is not assumed to be unrestricted cash.
This is a selected historical metric schedule, not complete statements, a three-statement model, consensus, forecasts or a valuation.
Full balance-sheet and cash-flow reconciliations are outside the selected metric scope and have not been performed.

business-overview.text: RTX supplies commercial aerospace systems, aircraft engines and defense technologies. It combines aircraft production and aftermarket exposure with government procurement.

evidence.locator: Item 1, General; Business Segments

business-overview.text_he: RTX מספקת מערכות לתעופה אזרחית, מנועי מטוסים וטכנולוגיות ביטחוניות. היא משלבת חשיפה לייצור מטוסים ולשירותי המשך עם רכש ממשלתי.

revenue-model-and-segments.text: The three segments are Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney and Raytheon. Revenue includes equipment sales, parts, repairs, engine support and defense contracts.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Business Segments

revenue-model-and-segments.text_he: שלושת המגזרים הם Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney ו־Raytheon. ההכנסות כוללות ציוד, חלקים, תיקונים, תמיכה במנועים וחוזים ביטחוניים.

products-and-services.text: Examples include Collins aircraft systems, Pratt & Whitney GTF and F135 engines, and Raytheon Patriot, AMRAAM and radar systems.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Business Segments / Collins Aerospace; Pratt & Whitney; Raytheon

products-and-services.text_he: דוגמאות הן מערכות מטוסים של Collins, מנועי GTF ו־F135 של Pratt & Whitney ומערכות Patriot, AMRAAM ומכ״מים של Raytheon.

customers-and-end-markets.text: Customers include airframe manufacturers, aircraft operators, U.S. government agencies and international buyers. Commercial aviation and defense create distinct demand drivers.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Business Segments; Sales and Customers

customers-and-end-markets.text_he: הלקוחות כוללים יצרני מטוסים, מפעילי מטוסים, גופי ממשל אמריקאיים וקונים בינלאומיים. לתעופה מסחרית ולביטחון גורמי ביקוש שונים.

industry-and-value-chain.text: Original engine and aircraft-system placements create later service opportunities. Supplier reliability, overhaul capacity and regulatory approval affect delivery and service economics.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition; Item 1A, suppliers and product quality

industry-and-value-chain.text_he: התקנת מנועים ומערכות במקור יוצרת הזדמנויות לשירות בהמשך. אמינות ספקים, קיבולת שיפוץ ואישור רגולטורי משפיעים על כלכלת המסירה והשירות.

competitive-landscape.text: The filing describes competition in aircraft equipment, spares and defense systems. Defense suppliers may also be partners or competitors on different programs.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition

competitive-landscape.text_he: הדוח מתאר תחרות בציוד מטוסים, בחלפים ובמערכות ביטחוניות. ספקים ביטחוניים עשויים להיות שותפים או מתחרים בתוכניות שונות.

moat-and-differentiation.text: Interpretation: installed engines and certified systems can support aftermarket durability. Alternative parts suppliers, pricing competition and maintenance obligations limit the advantage.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Competition; Item 1A, product performance

moat-and-differentiation.text_he: פרשנות: מנועים מותקנים ומערכות מוסמכות עשויים לתמוך בעמידות שירותי ההמשך. ספקי חלפים חלופיים, תחרות מחיר וחובות תחזוקה מגבילים את היתרון.

growth-drivers.text: Backlog increased from USD 289 billion at June 30, 2026 to USD 340 billion at September 30, 2026. Commercial backlog moved from USD 170 billion to USD 176 billion and defense from USD 119 billion to USD 164 billion. Third-quarter awards included multiyear Tomahawk and AMRAAM production contracts whose terms were not yet fully definitized.

evidence.locator: Second quarter 2026 highlights / backlog, line 39
Third quarter 2026 highlights / backlog and undefinitized production contracts, lines 39–40

growth-drivers.text_he: הצבר עלה מ־289 מיליארד דולר ב־30 ביוני 2026 ל־340 מיליארד ב־30 בספטמבר 2026. הצבר המסחרי עלה מ־170 ל־176 מיליארד דולר והצבר הביטחוני מ־119 ל־164 מיליארד. הזכיות ברבעון כללו חוזי ייצור רב־שנתיים ל־Tomahawk ול־AMRAAM שתנאיהם טרם סוכמו סופית.

growth-drivers.text: In the third quarter of 2026, Collins commercial aftermarket sales grew 9% year over year, Pratt & Whitney commercial aftermarket sales grew 21%, and Raytheon total sales grew 14%.

evidence.locator: Segment Results / Collins, Pratt & Whitney and Raytheon growth commentary, lines 123–125, 159–162 and 195

growth-drivers.text_he: ברבעון השלישי של 2026 מכירות שירותי ההמשך המסחריים של Collins צמחו ב־9% לעומת השנה הקודמת, מכירות שירותי ההמשך המסחריים של Pratt & Whitney צמחו ב־21%, וסך מכירות Raytheon צמח ב־14%.

growth-drivers.text: The July results reported commercial aftermarket and defense growth. Management plans capacity and productivity improvements; future backlog conversion still depends on execution.

evidence.locator: Opening management commentary; Segment Results
Opening management commentary, lines 47–48; Segment Results

growth-drivers.text_he: בתוצאות יולי דווחה צמיחה בשירותי תעופה ובביטחון. ההנהלה מתכננת שיפור קיבולת ופריון; המרה עתידית של הצבר עדיין תלויה בביצוע.

financial-performance.text: For July 1–September 30, 2026, GAAP sales were USD 24,965 million versus USD 22,478 million in the comparable 2025 quarter. Net income attributable to common shareowners was USD 2,583 million and diluted EPS was USD 1.89.

evidence.locator: Condensed Consolidated Statement of Operations / quarter ended September 30, 2026 and 2025; lines 236–333

financial-performance.text_he: בתקופה 1 ביולי–30 בספטמבר 2026 המכירות לפי GAAP היו 24,965 מיליון דולר לעומת 22,478 מיליון ברבעון המקביל ב־2025. הרווח הנקי לבעלי המניות הרגילות היה 2,583 מיליון דולר והרווח המדולל למניה היה 1.89 דולר.

financial-performance.text: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, company-defined non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS was USD 2.26 versus USD 1.70 a year earlier. The adjusted figure includes USD 0.25 of IEEPA cost recovery; the recovery was not removed by the non-GAAP reconciliation.

evidence.locator: Third quarter 2026 highlights / IEEPA recovery, lines 34–52; Adjusted Income, Earnings Per Share, and Effective Tax Rate / diluted EPS, lines 1066–1077

financial-performance.text_he: ברבעון שהסתיים ב־30 בספטמבר 2026 הרווח המדולל המתואם למניה, מדד non-GAAP לפי הגדרת החברה, היה 2.26 דולר לעומת 1.70 דולר שנה קודם. הנתון המתואם כולל 0.25 דולר מהחזר עלויות IEEPA; ההחזר לא נוטרל בהתאמת ה־non-GAAP.

financial-performance.text: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, GAAP operating cash flow was USD 2,868 million, including approximately USD 300 million of IEEPA recovery; capital expenditures were USD 749 million and non-GAAP free cash flow was USD 2,119 million. The comparable 2025 values were USD 4,639 million, USD 614 million and USD 4,025 million, respectively. Nine-month free cash flow was USD 6,306 million versus USD 4,745 million. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow less capital expenditures.

evidence.locator: Third quarter 2026 / cash flow commentary, lines 38 and 52; Free Cash Flow Reconciliation, lines 1198–1221

financial-performance.text_he: ברבעון שהסתיים ב־30 בספטמבר 2026 התזרים התפעולי לפי GAAP היה 2,868 מיליון דולר, כולל כ־300 מיליון דולר מהחזר IEEPA; ההשקעות ההוניות היו 749 מיליון והתזרים החופשי לפי non-GAAP היה 2,119 מיליון דולר. הנתונים המקבילים ב־2025 היו 4,639 מיליון, 614 מיליון ו־4,025 מיליון דולר, בהתאמה. התזרים החופשי בתשעת החודשים היה 6,306 מיליון דולר לעומת 4,745 מיליון. תזרים חופשי הוא תזרים תפעולי בניכוי השקעות הוניות.

financial-performance.text: Pratt & Whitney reported operating profit of USD 608 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 versus USD 751 million a year earlier. Its non-GAAP adjusted operating profit was USD 968 million: a USD 363 million customer-bankruptcy charge was excluded, while approximately USD 160 million of IEEPA recovery remained in adjusted profit.

evidence.locator: Pratt & Whitney segment results, lines 137–162; adjusted operating profit reconciliation, lines 824–839

financial-performance.text_he: Pratt & Whitney דיווחה על רווח תפעולי של 608 מיליון דולר ברבעון שהסתיים ב־30 בספטמבר 2026 לעומת 751 מיליון שנה קודם. הרווח התפעולי המתואם לפי non-GAAP היה 968 מיליון דולר: הוצאה של 363 מיליון דולר בשל פשיטת רגל של לקוח הוחרגה, ואילו כ־160 מיליון דולר מהחזר IEEPA נותרו ברווח המתואם.

catalysts.text: Announced September 15, 2026: Jill Albertelli is scheduled to succeed Shane Eddy as Pratt & Whitney president on January 1, 2027. Execution effects remain uncertain.

evidence.locator: Item 5.02, Retirement of Named Executive Officer

catalysts.text_he: בהודעה מ־15 בספטמבר 2026 נקבע כי Jill Albertelli צפויה להחליף את Shane Eddy כנשיאת Pratt & Whitney ב־1 בינואר 2027. השפעות המינוי על הביצוע עדיין אינן ודאיות.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Powder-metal issues require accelerated GTF inspections and additional shop visits. Costs depend on inspection findings, overhaul capacity and customer compensation; deteriorating estimates would weaken a cash-recovery thesis.

evidence.locator: Note 16, Pratt & Whitney Powder Metal Matter

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: בעיות אבקת מתכת מחייבות הקדמת בדיקות מנועי GTF וביקורי מוסך נוספים. העלויות תלויות בממצאי בדיקה, בקיבולת שיפוץ ובפיצוי לקוחות; הרעה באומדנים תחליש תזה של התאוששות מזומן.

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: Interpretation: raised cash guidance and a larger defense backlog strengthen the execution case, but the quarterly cash decline, recovery-assisted earnings and customer-credit charge limit confidence in recurring profit. A miss of the new cash-flow floor, repeat customer-credit losses or sustained defense sales contraction would weaken this thesis. These are analyst monitoring conditions, not company forecasts.

evidence.locator: Full-year outlook; Summary Financial Results; Pratt & Whitney results; Raytheon results

risks-and-thesis-breakers.text_he: פרשנות: העלאת תחזית המזומן והגידול בצבר הביטחוני מחזקים את תזת הביצוע, אך הירידה בתזרים הרבעוני, תמיכת ההחזרים ברווח וההוצאה בגין סיכון אשראי של לקוח מגבילים את הביטחון ברווחיות חוזרת. החמצת הרף התחתון החדש לתזרים, הפסדי אשראי חוזרים אצל לקוחות או ירידה מתמשכת במכירות הביטחוניות יחלישו את התזה. אלה תנאי מעקב אנליטיים, ולא תחזיות החברה.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Interpretation: upside combines aftermarket growth with profitable defense deliveries; downside includes engine remediation, supply constraints or contract overruns. No scenario probabilities or target prices are assigned.

evidence.locator: Item 2, Business Overview; Note 16, Commitments and Contingencies

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: פרשנות: בחיובי משתלבים צמיחת שירותי המשך ומסירות ביטחוניות רווחיות; בשלילי תיקון מנועים, מגבלות אספקה או חריגות חוזים. לא הוקצו הסתברויות או מחירי יעד.

scenarios-and-open-questions.text: Review scope: the current earnings comparison uses the complete issuer results releases. Changes in detailed engine-remediation cash obligations, customer-credit exposure and litigation remain unverified because the new SEC quarterly filing and current report, call transcript and presentation were not reviewed. Earlier filing-based risks retain their original evidence dates.

evidence.locator: Issuer release / financial statements, reconciliations and Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements
Preceding issuer release / financial statements and full-year outlook

scenarios-and-open-questions.text_he: היקף הבדיקה: השוואת התוצאות הנוכחית מבוססת על הודעות התוצאות המלאות של החברה. שינויים בהתחייבויות מזומן מפורטות לתיקון מנועים, בחשיפת אשראי ללקוחות ובהליכים משפטיים נותרו לא מאומתים, משום שהדוח הרבעוני והדיווח המיידי החדשים ל־SEC, תמליל השיחה והמצגת לא נבדקו. סיכונים המבוססים על דיווחים קודמים שומרים על מועדי הראיות המקוריים.

relationships-and-themes.text: Pratt & Whitney’s F135 powers Lockheed Martin’s F-35. This is a documented propulsion-platform relationship; shared defense exposure alone does not establish another customer relationship.

evidence.locator: Item 1, Pratt & Whitney / F135

relationships-and-themes.text_he: מנוע F135 של Pratt & Whitney מניע את מטוס F-35 של Lockheed Martin. זהו קשר מתועד בין הנעה לפלטפורמה; חשיפה ביטחונית משותפת לבדה אינה מוכיחה קשר לקוח נוסף.

recent-developments.text: On October 20, 2026, RTX raised full-year 2026 non-GAAP guidance from the July outlook: adjusted sales USD 95.0–96.0 billion to USD 97.0–97.5 billion; organic sales growth 8–9% to 10–11%; adjusted EPS USD 7.10–7.25 to USD 7.65–7.75; and free cash flow USD 8.50–8.75 billion to USD 9.0–9.2 billion. These ranges are forecasts.

evidence.locator: Updates outlook for full year 2026, lines 41–46
Updates outlook for full year 2026, lines 41–46

recent-developments.text_he: ב־20 באוקטובר 2026 העלתה RTX את תחזיות ה־non-GAAP לשנת 2026 לעומת תחזית יולי: מכירות מתואמות מ־95.0–96.0 ל־97.0–97.5 מיליארד דולר; צמיחה אורגנית במכירות מ־8–9% ל־10–11%; רווח מתואם למניה מ־7.10–7.25 ל־7.65–7.75 דולר; ותזרים חופשי מ־8.50–8.75 ל־9.0–9.2 מיליארד דולר. טווחים אלה הם תחזיות.

recent-developments.text: RTX raised its adjusted sales, adjusted EPS and free-cash-flow outlook on July 23, 2026. These were management forecasts, not realized annual results.

evidence.locator: Updates outlook for full year 2026
Updates outlook for full year 2026, lines 41–46

recent-developments.text_he: ב־23 ביולי 2026 RTX העלתה את תחזיות המכירות המתואמות, הרווח המתואם למניה והתזרים החופשי. אלה תחזיות הנהלה ולא תוצאות שנתיות ממומשות.

us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

us-gaap:ShortTermBorrowings.label: Short-term Debt
us-gaap:ShortTermBorrowings.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

limitations: Company Facts excludes custom taxonomy and dimensional/segment facts; absent data is not zero.
Company Facts does not carry the full filing context. Revisions may reflect restatements, stock splits, scope changes or tagging differences; flagged revisions are not automatically reconciled.
Fiscal labels come from primary filing focus and annual boundaries; SEC calendar frames are retained only as provenance.
Standalone quarters derived from cumulative values use exact matching fiscal starts/tags/units; cross-filing inputs are disclosed. EPS and weighted-average shares are never subtracted.

Debt lease coverage, short-term borrowings, principal versus carrying value, and unverified share cells require filing-level review before valuation. Explicit split and scope reviews cover exact approved observations only. Weighted-average diluted shares and period-end outstanding shares are separate concepts, and neither is a current quote-date share count.
Cash excludes marketable securities unless independently presented as short_term_investments. Cash plus investments is not assumed to be unrestricted cash.
This is a selected historical metric schedule, not complete statements, a three-statement model, consensus, forecasts or a valuation.
Full balance-sheet and cash-flow reconciliations are outside the selected metric scope and have not been performed.

thesis.reviewer: Codex AI — source-backed earnings comparison; not independent human review
thesis.summary_en: The full-year sales, EPS and cash outlook rose and defense backlog expanded. The earnings-quality check became more important: adjusted profit includes IEEPA recovery, Pratt excluded a new customer-bankruptcy charge, and quarterly cash flow fell. The thesis is stronger on demand, conditional on cash delivery and repeatable earnings.
thesis.summary_he: תחזיות המכירות, הרווח למניה והמזומן לשנה כולה עלו והצבר הביטחוני גדל. בדיקת איכות הרווח נעשתה חשובה יותר: הרווח המתואם כולל החזר IEEPA, Pratt החריגה הוצאה חדשה בגין פשיטת רגל של לקוח והתזרים הרבעוני ירד. התזה התחזקה בצד הביקוש, והיא תלויה בהשגת תזרים וברווחיות שניתן לשמר.

falsifiers.text_en: A FY2026 result or revised full-year guidance below USD 9,000 million would break the newly raised cash-flow floor. With nine-month FCF of USD 6,306 million, at least USD 2,694 million in Q4 is needed to reach that floor.
falsifiers.text_he: תוצאה לשנת 2026 או תחזית שנתית מעודכנת הנמוכה מ־9,000 מיליון דולר תשבור את הרף התחתון החדש לתזרים. לאחר תזרים של 6,306 מיליון בתשעת החודשים, דרושים לפחות 2,694 מיליון ברבעון הרביעי כדי להגיע לרף.
falsifiers.assumption_en: The USD 9,000 million floor is company guidance; using a miss as a thesis trigger is an analyst choice. The Q4 requirement is arithmetic, not additional management guidance.
falsifiers.assumption_he: הרף של 9,000 מיליון דולר מקורו בתחזית החברה; השימוש בהחמצתו כתנאי להפרכת התזה הוא בחירה אנליטית. הדרישה לרבעון הרביעי היא חישוב, ולא תחזית נוספת של ההנהלה.

falsifiers.assumption_en: The threshold equals the observed Q3 charge but the amount, recurrence window and thesis consequence are analyst-selected, not a company forecast or covenant.
